segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: I am glad that you came here.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: OK.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.text: ᎥᎬᏱ ᎨᎲ ᎬᏃᎯᏏ ᏄᏰᎸᏛ ᏥᏂᎾᏛᏁᎠ ᏣᎾᏔᏅ ᏓᎾᏕᎶᏆᏍᎬ ᏗᏂᏲᏟ ᎠᎭᎾ
segments.transliteration: vgvyi gehv gvnohisi nuyelvdv tsininadvnea tsanatanv danadeloquasgv diniyotli ahana
segments.translation: First let me tell you the reason we are doing this. You know that kids are going to school here?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: Yeah.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.text: ᏍᎩᏛ ᏢᏴ ᏛᎾᎴᏂ ᎠᎾᏛᏓᏍᏗᎲ Ꭿ ᏥᏂᏬᏂ ᏓᏂᏬᏂᏏ Ꮥ ᎤᎾᏛᏓᏍᏙᏗ ᏄᏍᏛ Ꮩ ᏣᎳᎩ ᎦᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᎲ ᏝᏅ ᏯᏩᏅᏘ ᏍᎩ Ᏼ ᏳᏛᏅᏟᎶᏝ ᎠᏎᏅ ᎤᎾᏛᏓᏍᏙᏗ -ᎤᏰᎵᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏐᎢᏂ ᎨᎲ ᏗᎨᏣᎵᏏ ᏏᏓᏁᎸ ᎢᏣᏙᏢᏒ ᏢᏴ ᏳᎾ,ᏚᎵ ᎨᎮᏍᏗ --ᎤᏅᏛᎪᏗ ᎯᏬᏂᏍᎬ ᏍᎩᏅ ᏳᎾᏓᏙᎮᎵᏝ ᎨᏒ ᏴᎨᎬᎵᏍᎪᎳᏓᏏ ᎨᎮᏍᏗ ᎤᎾᏛᏓᏍᏙᏗ ᎯᏬᏂᏍᎬ ᎢᏂᏬᏂᏍᎬ ᎴᏱᎩ ᎨᏒ ᎯᎢᎾᎾ ᎢᎾᎴᏂᏍᎬ ᏲᏁᎩ ᎬᏗ ᎧᎵ ᏕᏣᏙᎥ ᏍᎩᏃᎯᏏ
segments.transliteration: sgidv tlvyv dvnaleni anadvdasdihv hi tsiniwoni daniwonisi de unadvdasdodi nusdv do tsalagi gawonihisdi gehv tlanv yawanvti sgi yv yudvnvtlilotla asenv unadvdasdodi -uyelidi gesesdi soini gehv digetsalisi sidanelv itsadotlvsv tlvyv yuna,duli gehesdi --unvdvgodi hiwonisgv sginv yunadadohelitla gesv yvgegvlisgoladasi gehesdi unadvdasdodi hiwonisgv iniwonisgv leyigi gesv hiinana inalenisgv yonegi gvdi kali detsadov sginohisi
segments.translation: One of these days they are going to start listening to us, talking how we are. Or we are going to be talking, [for them] to listen to how Cherokee is spoken. I don’t know if they are going to get that far—but the reason is for them to listen. And, also, your grandchildren or your immediate family might want to someday listen to you talking. If they come here and ask, they will let them listen to you talking, or us talking. As we begin, tell me your full name in English.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: In English?

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Yes.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: Bird Wolfe is my name.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: What about in Cherokee?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: Tsisqwe Wahaya.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Tsisqwe Wahaya, ᎭᏢ ᏣᏁᏅ?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: I was born in Rocky Mountain.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: So, you were born just there, at your home?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: At my house.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: What was it like there at Rocky Mountain?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᎢᎦᏛ ᎤᏛᏁᏟᏴᏒ ᎪᎯᏴ ᏥᎩ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏥᏄᏍᏛ ᏱᏄᏍᏓ. ᏃᎴ ᏦᎢ ᎮᏂ ᏙᏓᎵ ᎯᎢ ᏗᏝ ᏅᏱ ᎣᏓᎳ ᏣᏃᏎᎰ ᎯᎢ ᏗᏝ Jackson Mountain ᎠᏃᏎᎰ ᎤᎾ ᎮᏂ ᏗᏝ ᎠᏩᏛᏒ, ᏣᎾᏛ Ꮎ Mankiller flats ᏣᏃᏎᎰ?
segments.transliteration: igadv udvnetliyvsv gohiyv tsigi tlesdi tsinusdv yinusda. nole tsoi heni dodali hii ditla nvyi odala tsanoseho hii ditla Jackson Mountain anoseho una heni ditla awadvsv, tsanadv na Mankiller flats tsanoseho?
segments.translation: It has really changed nowadays. It is not like it was. Also, there are three mountains. On this side, Rocky Mountain, they call it and on this side Jackson Mountain. I grew up that way. You know where they call Mankiller Flats?

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Yes.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: That way, to the south.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Oh. How many was in your family?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: There were five of us boys and three girls.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Did you all speak Cherokee?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: All of us spoke Cherokee.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.text: ᏙᏅ ᎤᏍᏕ ᎤᎾ ᏙᏗᏣᏛᏏᏗᏒ Ꮎ --ᏛᎬᏁᏟᏙᏗ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏥᏄᏍᏗ ᏧᏂᎾ ᎪᎯ ᏗᏂᏲᏟ ᏂᎾ Ꮩ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᎾᎡᏭ
segments.transliteration: donv usde una doditsadvsidisv na --dvgvnetlidodi gohusdi tsinusdi tsunina gohi diniyotli nina do usdi itsinaewu
segments.translation: What was it like for you growing up? The things you could play with compared to what children have today. What did you all have?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᏃᏭᏛ ᎣᏦᏢᏍᎬᏭ ᏦᎦᏁᎵᏙᏗ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏃᎴ ᎯᎢ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎨᏓᎵ ᏗᏝ ᎤᏪᏴ ᎤᏔᏂ ᎣᎦᏓᏬᏍᏗ ᎣᎪᏢᏒ ᎣᎩᏅᎦᎸᎰ ᏂᎨᎲ
segments.transliteration: nowudv otsotlvsgvwu tsoganelidodi gohusdi nole hii nusdv gedali ditla uweyv utani ogadawosdi ogotlvsv oginvgalvho nigehv
segments.translation: We just made things to play with. And just down the hill there was a big creek where we had a place to swim. We would clean it out.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: And you all just went there?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᎥᎥ ᎠᏎᏃ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᏲ ᎢᎾ ᏦᏣᏓᏅᏍᎬ Ꮲ ᎤᏣᏘᏂ ᏬᏤᎲ ᏃᎴ
segments.transliteration: vv aseno nigohilvyo ina tsotsadanvsgv tlv utsatini wotsehv nole
segments.translation: Yeah, but we always moved around, would live in a different place.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.text: Ꭳ ᏝᏕ ᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏭ ᏱᏥᏁᎴ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏏᏙᎮ?
segments.transliteration: o tlade sgi unawu yitsinele itsadanvsidohe?
segments.translation: Oh so you all just didn’t live there, you all moved around?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: No, we didn’t just live there, or stay there.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Where did you go to school?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: I went to school at Rocky Mountain.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Did you finish there?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: Uh uh, I didn’t finish.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: No?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᎦᎵᏉᎩᏁᏭ --ᏓᏥᏴᎵᏒ --ᏣᎩᏑᎸᎪᏨ Ꮎ ᎡᏙᏓ ᏥᏥᏍᏕᎸᎯᏙᎲ Ꮲ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ.
segments.transliteration: galiquoginewu --datsiyvlisv --tsagisulvgotsv na edoda tsitsisdelvhidohv tlv dulvwisdanehv.
segments.translation: No, I didn’t finish. I was going into the seventh grade and I quit. I started helping my dad where he was working.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.text: ᏙᏅ ᎠᏛᏁᎮ ᎨᎮ ᏍᎩᎾ ᏣᏙᏓ ᎢᏨᎵᏍᏕᎵᏙᏗ ᎠᏓᏁᏢᏍᎬ?
segments.transliteration: donv advnehe gehe sgina tsadoda itsvlisdelidodi adanetlvsgv?
segments.translation: What did your dad do to provide for you all?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: He did different things for work.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: And you were helping him?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: Ꭵ, ᏚᏯ ᏱᎩ ᏙᏣᏕᏍᎬ -ᎠᏂᎴ ᏱᎩ ᏅᏱᎴ ᏱᎩ ᏙᏍᏚᏖᏍᎪ Ꮲ ᏳᏚᎸ ᎩᎶ ᏠᎨᏏ ᎦᏅᎦᎸᏗ ᏃᎴ ᏙᏥᏏᎵᏛᏍᎬ
segments.transliteration: v, duya yigi dotsadesgv -anile yigi nvyile yigi dosdutesgo tlv yudulv gilo tlogesi ganvgalvdi nole dotsisilidvsgv
segments.translation: Yes, we would pick beans or strawberries. Or we would pick up rocks if someone wanted a field cleaned up, or we would build fences.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.text: Ꮭ ᏯᏅᏓᏗ ᎢᎦ ᎠᎾᏈᏱᎲ ᎠᏂ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎢᏣᏕᏍᎬ ᏥᎩ?
segments.transliteration: tla yanvdadi iga anaquiyihv ani nahiyu itsadesgv tsigi?
segments.translation: Do you remember how much they were paying for strawberries back then when you all were picking them?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: I think it was 10 cents.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Just 10 cents?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: Yeah.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.text: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎾᎯᏳ Ꮎ ᏥᎨᏒ ᎤᏃᏍᏗ ᎣᏍᏓ ᎢᎦ ᏲᏝ ᎨᎲ ᎠᏕᎳ ᎣᏝ
segments.transliteration: aseno nahiyu na tsigesv unosdi osda iga yotla gehv adela otla
segments.translation: But back then, with a dollar, you had quite a bit of money.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᎣᏍᏓ ᎢᎦ ᏲᏝ, ᏲᏩ ᎨᎲ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ, ᎯᎢᏃ ᎪᎯᏴ ᏥᎩ ᏲᏄᎸᏅ
segments.transliteration: osda iga yotla, yowa gehv gohusdi, hiino gohiyv tsigi yonulvnv
segments.translation: You would have quite a bit. You could buy quite something, but nowadays you couldn’t do it.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: You can’t buy anything for a dollar.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᎠᏗᏔᏍᏗᏭ Ꮎ ᏍᏊ ᏲᏄᎸᏍᎦ ᏍᎪᎯ ᏱᏓᏅᏙᏭ ᏥᎨᏒ pop ᎠᏟᏍᏛ ᎪᎯᎦ ᏧᎶᏒ ᎧᎵᏤᏥᏅ ᏍᏊ
segments.transliteration: aditasdiwu na squu yonulvsga sgohi yidanvdowu tsigesv pop atlisdv gohiga tsulosv kalitsetsinv squu
segments.translation: You couldn’t even buy something to drink. A bottle of pop was 10 cents a long time ago. Candy was, too.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.text: ᏍᎩᏛ ᎦᏥᏃᏎᎰ, ᎩᏄᏗᎡ ᏱᏥᏫᏗ ᎨᎲ ᎦᏥᏲᎮᎲ ᏗᏓᎾᏅ ᎠᏗᏔᏍᏗ chips Ꮎ honeybun ᏣᏃᎮᎰ ᏯᎩᏩᎭ ᎨᎲ ᎦᏥᏲᎮᎲ ᎩᏄᏗ ᎬᏗ
segments.transliteration: sgidv gatsinoseho, ginudie yitsiwidi gehv gatsiyohehv didananv aditasdi chips na honeybun tsanoheho yagiwaha gehv gatsiyohehv ginudi gvdi
segments.translation: That is what I tell them, that I would take a quarter to the store and get a drink, chips and what they call a honey bun. I could buy that, I tell them, with a quarter.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: And nowadays you couldn’t do it?

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.text: Ꮭ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏳᏍᏗ ᏱᎬᏲᏩ, Ꮭ ᏍᏊ ᏯᏩᏅᏘ ᏍᏊ bubble gum ᏫᎬᏲᏩᎯᏍᏗ ᏱᎩ ᎪᎯᏴ ᏥᎩ
segments.transliteration: tla gohusdi yusdi yigvyowa, tla squu yawanvti squu bubble gum wigvyowahisdi yigi gohiyv tsigi
segments.translation: Now you couldn’t buy either one. I also don’t even know if you could buy bubble gum nowadays.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: Ꮭ ᏱᎨᎵ, ᎡᎵᏭ ᎯᏍᎩ ᏯᏓᏅᏗ ᏴᏈᏱ ᏌᏭᎭ
segments.transliteration: tla yigeli, eliwu hisgi yadanvdi yvquiyi sawuha
segments.translation: I don’t think so. You would probably pay five cents for one.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.text: ᎾᏛ ᎤᏃᏍᏗ ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᏥᏓᏓᎾᏅ ᏥᏕᎪᏪᎵ ᏝᏅ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏃᏍᏗ ᏱᎩ ᏝᎧ
segments.transliteration: nadv unosdi tsugvwalodi tsidadananv tsidegoweli tlanv gohusdi unosdi yigi tlaka
segments.translation: Those stores that say it costs a dollar, there. Nothing is a dollar ain’t it?

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: No.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: They will charge you tax.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.text: ᎾᎯᏳ ᏣᏗᏍᎬ ᎦᏅᏓᏗᏍᎪ ᎠᎩᏍᏗ ᏥᏧᏣ ᏥᎨᏒ ᎤᎾ ᏅᏱ ᎣᏓᎳ ᏗᏝ --ᎡᎵ ᎯᎸᏍᎩ ᎢᎦ ᏴᏫ ᎠᏂ ᏥᏚᏂᏫᏒ ᏥᎨᏒ ᏂᎬ ᏙᎭ?
segments.transliteration: nahiyu tsadisgv ganvdadisgo agisdi tsitsutsa tsigesv una nvyi odala ditla --eli hilvsgi iga yvwi ani tsiduniwisv tsigesv nigv doha?
segments.translation: Back then, you were saying—I remember when I was a little boy, out there towards Rocky Mountain. There were several people that had strawberry patches everywhere, ain’t it?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: That’s true.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.text: --ᎪᎯᏴ ᏥᎩ ᎩᎶᎨ Ꮟ ᎤᏫᏎ ᎤᎾ ᏗᏝ ᎠᏂ
segments.transliteration: --gohiyv tsigi giloge si uwise una ditla ani
segments.translation: Nowadays, is there still someone that plants strawberries?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: I really don’t think so.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.translation: They don’t.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᎨᏍᏗ Ꮫ Ꮲ ᎰᏩ ᏴᏪᏙᎸ ᎪᎯᏴ ᏥᎩ ᎠᏯ. ᏃᎴ Ꮎ ᏧᎾᏕᎳᏆᏍᏗ ᏥᎩ ᎯᎢ ᏗᏝ ᏧᏓᎾᏅ ᎪᎯᎦ Lloyd Gibson ᏥᎨᎲ ᏧᏓᎾᏅ ᏂᎨᎵ
segments.transliteration: gesdi dv tlv howa yvwedolv gohiyv tsigi aya. nole na tsunadelaquasdi tsigi hii ditla tsudananv gohiga Lloyd Gibson tsigehv tsudananv nigeli
segments.translation: I hardly go anywhere nowadays. Also, where the school is, on this side, there was a store, a long time ago. The late Lloyd Gibson had a store there, I think.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: What about what you did for work?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏓᏭᏛ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ, ᏃᎴ ᏳᎾᏚᎵ ᎢᎦᏥᏍᏕᎵᎰ --ᏅᏱ ᏥᎩ ᏗᏏᎸᏛᏅᎴ ᏱᎩ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏓ ᏃᎴ ᏙᎬᏥᏯᏛᎷᎦᏁᎰ ᎤᏂᏫᏍᏒᏗ. ᏗᏂᎴᏅᎯᏓ ᏕᎬᏗᎲ
segments.transliteration: tsudalenvdawudv gohusdi, nole yunaduli igatsisdeliho --nvyi tsigi disilvdvnvle yigi tsudalenvda nole dogvtsiyadvluganeho uniwissvdi. dinilenvhida degvdihv
segments.translation: Just different things. And if someone wanted, I would help them with rocks or building fences. Just different things. And, also I would plow their gardens. I would use mules.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Oh you would use them to pull?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: Yeah.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Did you own them?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᎡᏙᏓᏛ ᏚᎾᏝᎥ, ᎤᎾ --ᎡᏙᏓ ᏧᏕᏅ Ꮭ ᏯᏩᏅᏘ ᏤᏙᎸ ᏱᎩ
segments.transliteration: edodadv dunatlav, una --edoda tsudenv tla yawanvti tsedolv yigi
segments.translation: My dad owned them. I don’t know if you have been where my dad used to live.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: I don’t think I have.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: Ꮎ ᎢᏦᏙ ᏣᏃᏎᎰ ᎤᎾ ᎦᏚᏏ – Ꮎ flat ᏥᏄᏍᏗ
segments.transliteration: na itsodo tsanoseho una gadusi – na flat tsinusdi
segments.translation: You know where they call Echota, up there on the hill, where that flat is?

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: There?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: …He bought that. Then we moved there.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Did he plant things?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᎣᏥᏫᏒᏍᎬ, ᏄᎾ ᏱᎩ ᏎᎷᎴ ᏱᎩ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ
segments.transliteration: otsiwisvsgv, nuna yigi selule yigi tsudalenvdv
segments.translation: We planted things, like potatoes and corn, and different things.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.text: ᏍᎩᎾ Ꮩ ᎠᏛᏁᎮ ᎠᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗᎮ ᏄᎾ Ꮩ ᏕᎬᏁᎮ ᏓᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗᎮ?
segments.transliteration: sgina do advnehe asquanigodihe nuna do degvnehe dasquanigodihe?
segments.translation: How did he preserve that.? How did he preserve the potatoes?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᎾᏛ Ꮎ ᎣᏍᏗ ᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᎧᏁᏍᎩ ᎦᏄᎸᎴ ᏱᎩ ᎧᏁᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏥᎩ ᎭᏫᏂ ᏗᏝ ᏓᎾᎲᏍᎬ ᏥᎨᎲ ᎡᏥ ᎮᎾ ᏎᎦᏨ ᏕᎦᏝᏛᏅᏍᎬ
segments.transliteration: nadv na osdi adanelv kanesgi ganulvle yigi kanesgi na tsigi hawini ditla danahvsgv tsigehv etsi hena segatsv degatladvnvsgv
segments.translation: He put them in that little building, and put them beneath grass and hay. My mom would can things.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Did those potatoes make it through the winter?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: No.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Did you all eat them up?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: yeah, ᎤᏴᏟᎡ ᏱᏄᎵᏍᏛᏂ ᏱᎨᏥᏒᏂ ᎩᎳᏭ ᏱᎪᎯᏓ
segments.transliteration: yeah, uyvtlie yinulisdvni yigetsisvni gilawu yigohida
segments.translation: Yeah, if it gets too cold, it would kill them quickly.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: It would kill them.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: Yes.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.text: ᎾᎨ ᏍᏊ ᎡᎾᎨ ᎡᎯ ᎠᏍᏆᏂᎪᏛᎲᏍᎨ ᏣᏥ ᏥᎨᏒ
segments.transliteration: nage squu enage ehi asquanigodvhvsge tsatsi tsigesv
segments.translation: Did she also preserve things from the woods?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᏍᏊᏛ ᎠᏍᏆᏂᎪᏛᎲᏍᎬ ᎡᎾᎨ ᎡᎯ ᎧᏄᎦᏟ ᎢᎦ ᏣᎦᏝᏗᎲ
segments.transliteration: squudv asquanigodvhvsgv enage ehi kanugatli iga tsagatladihv
segments.translation: She also preserved things from the woods, like blackberries, she canned them.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: What about onion, and polk salad, things like that?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: And onion and polk salad.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.text: ᎢᏥᏴᎸᏍᎩ Ꭸ ᎨᎮ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎡᎾᎨ ᎡᎯ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ
segments.transliteration: itsiyvlvsgi ge gehe nahiyu enage ehi gohusdi
segments.translation: Did you all look for things, from the woods back then?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: We would look for things.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.translation: And you all found it?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: Yes.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.text: boy, ᎯᎢᎾ ᎬᏯᏛᏛᎮ ᎦᏓᏅᏖᏍᎪ ᏍᏊ ᎠᏮᏏ ᏗᏝ ᏫᎨᎲ. ᎠᎩᎸᏉᏓ ᎠᎩᏛᏗ ᎪᎯᏴ ᏥᎩ Ꮟ ᎧᎮ ᏥᏄᏍᏛ ᏥᏗᏩᏘᏍᎬ ᎢᎾᎨ ᎡᎯ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏍᎩ ᏱᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗ Ꮟ ᎧᎮ ᏍᎩ ᏱᏂᏓᏛᎩ ᏙᎨ ᎮᎵᏍᎪ?
segments.transliteration: boy, hiina gvyadvdvhe gadanvtesgo squu awvsi ditla wigehv. agilvquoda agidvdi gohiyv tsigi si kahe tsinusdv tsidiwatisgv inage ehi gohusdi sgi yinigalisdi si kahe sgi yinidadvgi doge helisgo?
segments.translation: Let me ask you this, I think about this even to myself. I like to ask this nowadays—do you think we can still find things from the woods like we used to? If we had to do that, could we still do it, what do you think?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᏳᏍᏛᏅ ᎨᎵᎲ ᎠᏯ ᎨᎲ Ꭱ, ᎢᎾᎨ ᎡᎯ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏳᏂᏩᏛᎯ Ꭱ ᏯᏂᎾᏚᎩᏛ ᏴᏫ ᏯᏂᎾᏚᎩ ᏴᏫᏅ ᏍᏊ ᏴᏂᏩᎯ ᎩᎳᏫᏴ ᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᎵᎰ --ᎠᏢᏗᏍᎪᏭ ᎨᎵ. ᎨᎵᎰ Ꮩ ᎮᏂ ᏥᏃᎮ Ꮭ ᎮᏂ ᎰᏩ ᏱᎬᏴᏩᏗ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎪᎯᏴ ᏥᎩ. ᏲᎵᏦᏂ ᎮᏂ ᏯᏯᎴᏂ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ
segments.transliteration: yusdvnv gelihv aya gehv e, inage ehi gohusdi yuniwadvhi e yaninadugidv yvwi yaninadugi yvwinv squu yvniwahi gilawiyv sgi nigeliho --atlvdisgowu geli. geliho do heni tsinohe tla heni howa yigvyvwadi gohusdi gohiyv tsigi. yolitsoni heni yayaleni gohusdi
segments.translation: This is what I think—when they find something from the woods people will sell it. They will sell it, and people will buy it quickly. That is why I think things are disappearing. Like you said, you can hardly find anything nowadays. You could not find anything.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.text: ᎪᎯᎦ ᎮᏂ ᏥᎨᎲ ᎢᎸᏍᎩᏭ Ꮥ ᎾᏕᏘᏱ ᏥᎨᎲ ᏝᏙ ᏍᏊ ᎪᎯᎦ ᏅᏃ ᎤᏩᏍᏛ Ꮲ ᎧᏄᎦᏟ ᏳᏗ ᏥᎨᎲ ᏙᎭ
segments.transliteration: gohiga heni tsigehv ilvsgiwu de nadetiyi tsigehv tlado squu gohiga nvno uwasdv tlv kanugatli yudi tsigehv doha
segments.translation: Long time ago, or just a few years ago. It has not been that long. There would be blackberries, just on the side of the road somewhere, ain’t it. And wild plums, and also grapes would be hanging somewhere.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: Yeah.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.text: ᏆᏄᏍᏗ Ꮎ ᎠᏁᏯᏔ ᎾᏅ ᏃᎴ ᎤᏂᏖᎸᎳᏗ ‘Ꮲ ᏳᎾᏛ ᏥᎨᎲ
segments.transliteration: quanusdi na aneyata nanv nole unitelvladi ‘tlv yunadv tsigehv
segments.translation: Wild plums and grapes were around back then.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: You can’t find them.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.translation: Really.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᏌᎶᎵ Ꮫ ᎬᏟᏅ ᏯᏂᎩ ᎠᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎪ ᎤᎾ
segments.transliteration: saloli dv gvtlinv yanigi analisdayvhvsgo una
segments.translation: Squirrels and coons will eat it. They will be eating.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.text: ᎾᎮᏂ ᏍᏊ ᎧᏩᏯ ᏥᎩ ᏣᎩᏩᏛᎲ ᎯᎾ ᎡᏘ ᏥᎨᎲ ᏣᏤᎲᏍᎬ ᏍᏗ ᏧᏔ, ᏞᎦᏅ ᏯᎩᏘᏓ ᏯᏪᏙᎵ ᏳᏔᎭ ᏍᏊ ᏍᏗᏭ ᎢᎦ ᎠᏪᎵᏍᏒ, ᏨᏪᏙᎸᎡ Ꮭ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏳᏖ. ᎬᏂᏍᎪᏭ Ꮟ ᎴᏱᎩ ᏄᏩᏂᏒᎾ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᎨ
segments.transliteration: naheni squu kawaya tsigi tsagiwadvhv hina eti tsigehv tsatsehvsgv sdi tsuta, tleganv yagitida yawedoli yutaha squu sdiwu iga awelissv, tsvwedolve tla gohusdi yute. gvnisgowu si leyigi nuwanisvna gohusdi uge
segments.translation: Even blueberries—I found some just this last year. They were just starting to ripen. And I thought, if I wait a little while and come back there will be some there. Even if it’s a little bit, I thought. When I came back, there was nothing there. While it was ripening or before it ripened, something ate it.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: Something was eating it?

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.text: ᎪᎯᎩᏴ ᏥᎨᎲ –ᎢᎦ ᏳᏩᏂᏩᏔ ᏥᎨᎲ Ꮲ.. ᎠᏩᏅᏘᏅ.. ᏙᎯᏳ ᎠᏬᎯᏳᏐ ᎢᏗᏣᎳᎩ Ꮭ ᏍᏊ Ꮩ ᎢᏗᏣᎳᎩ ᏍᎩᏭ ᎢᎦ ᎡᎦᏓᏁᎳᏁᎸ ᎨᎮ Ꭿ ᏍᎩᎾᎾ – ᏍᎩᏂ ᏣᏗ ᏅᎬᏗᎲᎾ ᏱᎩ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏛᏣᏲᎱᏎᎵ ᎮᏂ. ᏍᎩ ᎾᏩᎵᏍᏓᏁᎰ ᏯᏩᏓᏅᏖᏢᏂ
segments.transliteration: gohigiyv tsigehv –iga yuwaniwata tsigehv tlv.. awanvtinv.. dohiyu awohiyuso iditsalagi tla squu do iditsalagi sgiwu iga egadanelanelv gehe hi sginana – sgini tsadi nvgvdihvna yigi gohusdi dvtsayohuseli heni. sgi nawalisdaneho yawadanvtetlvni
segments.translation: A long time ago they would go find quite a bit somewhere. I really believe us Cherokees, or maybe not just us Cherokees, we have been provided with that. Like you said—if you don’t use those things, you are going to lose it. That's what I feel when I think about it.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᎠᏯ Ꮫ ᏍᏊ ᎤᏠᏱ ᎾᏩᎵᏍᏓᏁᎰ ᎨᎲ. ᏃᎴ Ꭱ ᏦᏥᏃᎭᎴᎪ ᏥᎨᎲ ᎠᏫ ᏱᎩ ᏥᏍᏚ ᎴᏱᎩ ᏌᎶᎵ ᎴᏱᎩ. ᎯᏃ ᏥᏍᏚ Ꮭ ᎰᏩ ᏱᏛᎬᏴᏩᏗ ᎪᎯᏴ ᏥᎩ ᏥᏈᏍᏙ ᏳᎾᎵᏍᏛᏅ ᎨᎰ
segments.transliteration: aya dv squu utloyi nawalisdaneho gehv. nole e tsotsinohalego tsigehv awi yigi tsisdu leyigi saloli leyigi. hino tsisdu tla howa yidvgvyvwadi gohiyv tsigi tsiquisdo yunalisdvnv geho
segments.translation: I feel the same way. We used to go hunting, for deer or rabbits or squirrel. And now, you can't hardly find rabbits, nowadays. There used to be lots of them.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Me --

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: -- they are disappearing, I think.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Do you know my brother, Stanley?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: Yeah.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.text: ᏍᎩ ᎮᏂ ᏥᏥᏝᏫᏍᏛᏅ ᏝᎦ boy ᎢᎦ Ꮫ Ꮭ ᏯᏩᏅᏘ ᏍᏊ ᏁᎳᏚ ᏱᎩ Ꮲ ᏔᎵᏍᎪ ᎴᏱᎩ Ꮲ ᏥᏙᏍᏗᎾᏝᎥ ᏥᏍᏚ ᏗᏂᎨᎯᏙ ᏙᏓᏩᏍᎬᏅ ᏱᎩ ᏒᎯᏰ ᏗᏝ ᏃᎴ Ꮎ Little Jack, Little Jack Vann ᏥᎨᎲ ᏱᏓᏘᏃᎩ ᏥᎨᎲ ᎩᏟ ᏍᎩᏂ ᏙᏣᏘᏁᎪ ᎨᎲ. Boy ᏯᏁᏡᎲᎩ ᏛᏲ ᏥᏍᏚ ᎠᏂᎨᎯᏙᎲ Ᏺ ᏍᎩᎾ ᏣᏗ ᏍᏓᏯ ᏱᏄᎵᏍᏛᏂᏟ ᎠᎭᏂ ᎮᎵ ᎢᏍ ᎠᏯ ᏥᏄᏍᏗ ᏥᏗᎩᎶᏌ ᎮᎵᎢᏍ ᏯᎯᏗ ᏱᏂᎦᎵᏍᏓᏏ ᏏᏅ Ꮎ ᎣᏂ ᎪᎯᏴ ᏥᎩ ᏣᏁᎯ ᏗᏂᏲᏟ?
segments.transliteration: sgi heni tsitsitlawisdvnv tlaga boy iga dv tla yawanvti squu neladu yigi tlv talisgo leyigi tlv tsidosdinatlav tsisdu dinigehido dodawasgvnv yigi svhiye ditla nole na Little Jack, Little Jack Vann tsigehv yidatinogi tsigehv gitli sgini dotsatinego gehv. Boy yanetluhvgi dvyo tsisdu anigehidohv yo sgina tsadi sdaya yinulisdvnitli ahani heli is aya tsinusdi tsidigilosa heliis yahidi yinigalisdasi sinv na oni gohiyv tsigi tsanehi diniyotli?
segments.translation: I used to stay with him for a little while. Boy, there were a lot. I don’t know, we had about 18 or 20 rabbit chasers. On Sunday afternoons that Little Jack, Little Jack Vann, would bring dogs. We took them. Boy them dogs would be hollering and chasing rabbits. Like he is saying—if it becomes hard here, do you think, based on what we have been through, do you think it would be easier for us, than the children that live nowadays?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᎪᎯᏴ ᏥᎩ ᏣᏁᎯ ᏗᏂᏲᏟ -- ᏥᏈᏍᏓ ᎤᎾᏕᎳᏆᏍᏗ ᎨᎵᎰ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ. ᎢᎦᏓ Ꮎ ᏗᏂᏲᏟ ᏳᏂᏲᏏ Ꮫ – ᎡᎾᎨ ᎡᎯ -- ᎡᎵ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏱᎬᏂᎦ bologna Ꮥ -ᎩᎶᏫᏴ ᏯᏂᎦ
segments.transliteration: gohiyv tsigi tsanehi diniyotli -- tsiquisda unadelaquasdi geliho gohusdi. igada na diniyotli yuniyosi dv – enage ehi -- eli gohusdi yigvniga bologna de -gilowiyv yaniga
segments.translation: The children that live nowadays, I think have lots of things to learn. Some children would not like something from the woods. There ain’t no way they would eat it. But if it's bologna they would eat it quickly.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.text: ᎾᎯᏳᏅ ᏥᎨᎲ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᎢ ᏳᏛᎾ ᏣᏥ ᏣᎵᏏ Ꮭ ᏱᏔᏛᏛᎾ ᎤᏞ ᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏝᎲ ᎩᎶᏫᏴ Ꮫ ᏳᏦᏝ ᎨᎲ. ᏙᎭ?
segments.transliteration: nahiyunv tsigehv alisdayvdii yudvna tsatsi tsalisi tla yitadvdvna utle yusdi atlahv gilowiyv dv yutsotla gehv. doha?
segments.translation: Back then when your mom or grandma said “It's time to eat,” you would not ask “What's on the table?” You would be sitting there, quickly, ain’t it?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: That’s true. That’s the way it was a long time ago.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: If you didn’t eat, you just starve, ain’t it?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: You would be starving.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: They were not going to cook you what you wanted.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.text: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏥᎩᎸᏉᏛᏅ ᏳᏍᏗᏭ ᎠᏝᎲ ᏙᎭ? ᎦᏚ ᎠᏑᏍᏗ ᏄᏂ ᏚᏯ. ᏳᏎᎦᏨᏅ ᎭᏫᏯ ᏯᏝ ᎤᏟᎯ ᏲᏍᏗ ᏥᎨᎲ. ᏍᎩᎾ ᏝᎦ ᏥᎾᏏᏄᎦ Ꮎ ᏧᎾᏕᎳᏆᏍᏗ ᏥᏣᎴᏅᎲ ᎣᏍᏗᏍ ᏲᏁᎩ ᎯᏬᏂᎮ?
segments.transliteration: aseno tsigilvquodvnv yusdiwu atlahv doha? gadu asusdi nuni duya. yusegatsvnv hawiya yatla utlihi yosdi tsigehv. sgina tlaga tsinasinuga na tsunadelaquasdi tsitsalenvhv osdis yonegi hiwonihe?
segments.translation: But we liked what was on the table—bread, gravy, and potatoes, and beans, and by chance if there was any meat, it would be even better. What about, let's back up for a little while. When you started school, did you speak English well?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: I didn’t learn well ‘til later.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.translation: When you began school?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: Yes.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.translation: Did you have a rough time?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: Yeah, I had a rough time.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.translation: Did they tell you not to speak Cherokee?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᏞᏍᏗ ᎸᎯᏳ ᎠᎩᏍᎦᏨ ᏱᎨᎮ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏯ
segments.transliteration: tlesdi lvhiyu agisgatsv yigehe gilo aya
segments.translation: Nobody ever told me not to.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.text: ᎡᎵ ᏅᎮ ᎯᎸᏍᎩ ᏂᏥᎡ ᎢᏥᏣᎳᎩ ᏙᎭ ᎢᏣᎴᏅ ᎡᎵᏭ
segments.transliteration: eli nvhe hilvsgi nitsie itsitsalagi doha itsalenv eliwu
segments.translation: There were probably quite a few of you Cherokees when you started, ain’t it?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᎥᎥ, ᎯᎮᏂ ᎪᎯᏴ ᏥᎩ ᎠᏢᏛᏗ ᎮᏂ ᏣᎳᎩ ᏃᎴ ᎤᏂᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎣᏎᏍᏕ ᏩᎾᏕᎳᏆᎥ ᎡᎵ ᏱᏂᏛᏝᏃᎮᏗ ᎣᏂ ᎠᏁᎯ
segments.transliteration: vv, hiheni gohiyv tsigi atlvdvdi heni tsalagi nole uniwonihisdi osesde wanadelaquav eli yinidvtlanohedi oni anehi
segments.translation: Yes, and nowadays Cherokee is disappearing. And if they learn to speak it well, we might be able to talk to the young people.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.text: ᎡᎵᏭᏅ ᎠᏎ ᏥᏈᏍᏗ ᏤᏲᏁ ᏥᏤᏲᎾ ᏣᏙᏓ ᏥᎨᏒ
segments.transliteration: eliwunv ase tsiquisdi tseyone tsitseyona tsadoda tsigesv
segments.translation: Your dad has probably taught you a lot, when he taught you.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᎡᎵ Ꮫ ᎣᏏ ᎠᏪᏲᎾ ᎠᏎᏃ ᎢᎦ ᎠᏮᎨᏫᏌᏗ. --ᎠᏮᎨᏍᎪ ᏳᏍᏗ
segments.transliteration: eli dv osi aweyona aseno iga awvgewisadi. --awvgesgo yusdi
segments.translation: He taught me quite a bit, but I am forgetful nowadays. I forget things.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Don’t you remember the most important things?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: I’ll quickly remember… Sometimes it happens.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: You remember.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: I remember.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: He taught you to work.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᎥᎥ, ᎥᎾ Ꮎ ᏑᏕᏘᏴᏗ ᏥᏓᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏏ ᎠᏥᎵ ᏅᏃ seventy one ᏥᎨᎲ. ᎤᎾ ᏃᎴ Ꭱ Tulsa ᏥᏛᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸ Ꮎ ᎠᏂᏧᏥ ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ Ford place Ꭲ ᏍᏊ ᏑᏕᏘᏴᏗ ᎢᎪᎯᏓ ᏃᎴ ᎠᎩᎷᏥᏅ -ᎾᏭ ᎠᏩᎴᏅᎲ Ꮎ ᏐᏈᎵ ᏕᏥᏏᎾᎯᏍᏗᎲ. ᏃᎴ ᏗᎦᏚᎴᏂ ᎢᎦ ᎣᏍᏓ ᏂᎬᏁᎲ ᎡᎵ ᎠᏩᏕᎳᏆᎥ ᎤᎾ -ᏕᏥᎪᏩᏘᎲ ᏳᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᎲ. ᎯᎢᏃ ᎪᎯᏴ ᏥᎩ ᎠᎩᏄᎸᎲᏍᎩ
segments.transliteration: vv, vna na sudetiyvdi tsidagilvwisdasi atsili nvno seventy one tsigehv. una nole e Tulsa tsidvgilvwisdanelv na anitsutsi dunilvwisdanehv Ford place i squu sudetiyvdi igohida nole agilutsinv -nawu awalenvhv na soquili detsisinahisdihv. nole digaduleni iga osda nigvnehv eli awadelaquav una -detsigowatihv yusdi nigalisdihv. hiino gohiyv tsigi aginulvhvsgi
segments.translation: I worked for a year on the railroad in ‘71. Then I worked in Tulsa, where those boys were working at that Ford place, for a year too. Then when I came back, I started training horses and I would fix cars. I was able to learn by just seeing what was happening. Nowadays I can't do it.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Do you have horses? Five?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: I have five.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.text: ᎠᏯ ᏍᏊ ᎨᎵ ᎯᏍᎩ. ᏲᏍᎩᏂ ᏙᏛᏥᏅᏗᏂ Ᏺ
segments.transliteration: aya squu geli hisgi. yosgini dodvtsinvdini yo
segments.translation: I think I have five too. But I am going to sell them.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᎠᏯ ᏛᎮ ᏍᏊ ᎤᏠᏱ ᏂᏛᏩᎵᏍᏓᏁᎵ. ᎠᎩᎪᏩᏛᏗ ᎠᎩᏄᎸᎲᏍᎪ ᎠᎭᏂ ᏗᏝ ᎡᎵ ᎮᏂ ᏍᏓᏯ ᏣᎩᏍᏆᎶᎥ ᏌᏊ ᏳᏩᎪᏗ ᏐᏈᎵ ᏣᎩᎶᏛᏅ ᏧᏩᎩᏢᏥᏢ gravelᎢ ᏥᏏᎾᎯᏍᏗᎲ ᏍᏊ ᎠᎴ ᎾᎩᏏᎾᎯᏍᏛᏅᏭ
segments.transliteration: aya dvhe squu utloyi nidvwalisdaneli. agigowadvdi aginulvhvsgo ahani ditla eli heni sdaya tsagisqualov saquu yuwagodi soquili tsagilodvnv tsuwagitlvtsitlv graveli tsisinahisdihv squu ale nagisinahisdvnvwu
segments.translation: I think the same is going to happen to me. I can't see on this side [gestures]. I hit my head real hard when a horse bucked me off, and I fell on top of some gravel. I was training it, too, and it almost trained me.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.text: ᏲᏁᎦ --ᏱᎬᏔᏂ I break horses ᏴᏗ ᏂᎯᏅ ᎭᎴ ᏍᎩ ᏂᏨᏁᎴ
segments.transliteration: yonega --yigvtani I break horses yvdi nihinv hale sgi nitsvnele
segments.translation: If you use English, “I break horses”, you would say. And you—it almost broke you.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: It almost killed me.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: That dance place, stomp ground, they had, do they still have it?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: We still have it.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Are you still involved?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: Ꭵ, ᎡᏙᏓ ᏁᎲᎾ ᏥᏄᎵᏍᏛᏅ ᎠᏯ ᏧᏩᎩᏴᏍᏛᏅ. ᏂᎦᏗ ᏩᏩᏘᏲᏁᎸ ᎾᎮᏂ ᎠᏂᏐ Ꮭ ᏳᎾᏚᎵᎮ. ᎠᏮᏌᏭ Ꮫ ᏳᏍᏗ ᏃᏭ ᎤᎾ
segments.transliteration: v, edoda nehvna tsinulisdvnv aya tsuwagiyvsdvnv. nigadi wawatiyonelv naheni aniso tla yunadulihe. awvsawu dv yusdi nowu una
segments.translation: Yeah, when Dad passed away I took over. It was all up to me, the others didn’t want it. I am about the only one there now.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Do they still dance?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᏏᏛ ᎣᏣᎵᏍᎩᏍᎪ ᏙᏛᏩᏍᎬ ᏱᎩ ᎢᎦ ᏒᎯᏰ ᏗᏝ ᎣᏣᏁᏦᏍᎪ ᎢᎦ Ꮕ ᏱᎩ ᏙᏣᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎪ ᎡᎵ ᎤᎪᏗ ᏄᎾᎵᏍᏗᎰ Ᏺ ᏃᎴ Ꮎ ᏗᏂᏲᏟ ᏱᎩ ᏙᏤᏲᎲᏍᎪ --ᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏃᎴ ᎾᏰᎵᏓᏍᏗ ᏱᎩ. Ꭿ ᎮᎾ Ꮠ ᎧᎴᏍᏗ ᎩᎳ ᏛᏲᏥᏍᏚᎢᏏ Ᏺ Ꮎ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᎩᏍᏗ
segments.transliteration: sidv otsalisgisgo dodvwasgv yigi iga svhiye ditla otsanetsosgo iga nv yigi dotsalisdayvhvsgo eli ugodi nunalisdiho yo nole na diniyotli yigi dotseyohvsgo --sgi nusdv nole nayelidasdi yigi. hi hena so kalesdi gila dvyotsisduisi yo na unalisgisdi
segments.translation: We still dance. On Sunday afternoon we play ball, and at noon we eat. There are usually a lot of people. We also teach the children things like that, as well as how to make the sounds. This next month, we are going to open up the dance grounds.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: When it kinda warms up.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᎠᎦᏅᏬᏒ ᎠᎬᏱ ᏙᏓᏫᏕᏂ. ᎤᎾᏛᏅᏍᏛᏃᏅ Ꮫ ᎠᎾᏗᎰ Ꮎ ᎠᏁᏙ ᎤᎾ
segments.transliteration: aganvwosv agvyi dodawideni. unadvnvsdvnonv dv anadiho na anedo una
segments.translation: When it warms up, on the first Saturday. The people that go there say they are ready.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: They are in a hurry huh?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: They are in a hurry.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.text: ᎭᎳᎩ Ꮎ ᎪᎯᎳ ᏂᎪᏢᏐ ᏍᎩᎾ Ꮎ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᎩᏍᏗ, ᎭᎳ Ꮎ ᎪᎯᎳ ᏄᏍᏙ ᏍᎩᎾ
segments.transliteration: halagi na gohila nigotlvso sgina na unalisgisdi, hala na gohila nusdo sgina
segments.translation: How long has that place been there, where they dance, the stomp ground, how long has it existed?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᎡᎵᏛ ᎪᎯᏗ, ᎢᎸᏍᎩ ᎮᏂ ᏳᏂᎲᏗ ᎠᏩᎨᏩ ᏳᏂᎲᏓ ᏍᎩ ᎾᎮᏂ ᎠᏩᏅᏘ ᏥᎨᎲ Beaver Gap ᎤᎾ ᎮᏂ ᏣᎲ ᎤᎾ ᏃᏭ ᏭᏂᎲᏏ Ꮓ Tylor Springs. ᎤᎾ Ꮓ ᏦᏥᏁᎵ ᎡᏙᏓ ᏧᏩᏒ ᎤᎾ ᏧᏂᏲᏢ Ꮓ ᎤᎾ ᏃᏭ ᎠᎯ
segments.transliteration: elidv gohidi, ilvsgi heni yunihvdi awagewa yunihvda sgi naheni awanvti tsigehv Beaver Gap una heni tsahv una nowu wunihvsi no Tylor Springs. una no tsotsineli edoda tsuwasv una tsuniyotlv no una nowu ahi
segments.translation: It's been a long time. Several times they moved it… I forget how many times they have moved it. I know it was at Beaver Gap—that is where it was. When they moved it from there, it was Tyler Springs. And there where we live, when Dad bought it, they brought it there, and it is there now.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.text: -- --ᎭᎳᎩ ᏛᏢ Ꭷ ᎾᏕᏘᏱᏴ ᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏙ -ᏚᏳᏓᎴᏅᏗ ᏃᎴ ᏲᎵᎬᏛᏓᏏ ᏙᎭ?
segments.transliteration: -- --halagi dvtlv ka nadetiyiyv sgi nusdo -duyudalenvdi nole yoligvdvdasi doha?
segments.translation: How many years has it been there, since the beginning? It makes you curious, ain’t it?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᏙᏅ, yeah ᎡᎵᏭ ᎪᎯᎦ ᎾᎰ ᏍᎩᎾ ᎦᏘ.
segments.transliteration: donv, yeah eliwu gohiga naho sgina gati.
segments.translation: Really. That stomp ground has been there a long time.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.translation: When you were born, when [you] came into [life], when you were born, was it already there?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: It already was.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Your dad was keeping it running back then.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: My dad kept it running.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.text: ᏂᎾ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏃᏭ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎦᎵᏍᏔᏅ Ꮩ ᎮᎵ ᏓᎦᎵᏍᏛᏂ? ᎮᎵ Ꭸ ᎩᎶ ᏓᎠᏴᏍᏛᏂ?
segments.transliteration: nina ilvhiyu nowu gohusdi galistanv do heli dagalisdvni? heli ge gilo daayvsdvni?
segments.translation: What if someday something happens? What do you think is going to happen to it? Do you think someone will take over?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᎠᏂᏔᎵᏛ ᎠᏁᏙᎰ ᏧᏂᏓᎨ ᎠᏂᏧᏥ ᎤᎾᏚᎵ, ᏍᏊ ᎠᎮ ᏙᎦᏥᏲᎯᏐᏁᎵ
segments.transliteration: anitalidv anedoho tsunidage anitsutsi unaduli, squu ahe dogatsiyohisoneli
segments.translation: Two young boys, that go there, want to. I guess I am going to hand it over to them.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Do they sing? You all say, or what do you call that, when they go around?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: They say they sing.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.text: ᎾᏂ ᎠᎭ ᎠᏂᏰᎵᎰ ᏣᎾᏗᎰ Ꮩ ᎤᏍᏗ ᏄᏍᏗ ᏍᎩᎾ?
segments.transliteration: nani aha aniyeliho tsanadiho do usdi nusdi sgina?
segments.translation: What about they say the chant, what is that?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: The one that goes first, is the one that chants.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: So, the others follow?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᎠᎾᏓᏍᏓᏩᏕᎪ ᏃᏭ. ᎤᏁᎳᏅ ᏏᏅ Ꮎ ᎠᏂᎨᏯ --ᏔᎵᏁ ᏣᏂ ᏓᎦᏏ ᏧᎾᏅᏒᏛᏍᎩ ᏃᏭ
segments.transliteration: anadasdawadego nowu. unelanv sinv na anigeya --taline tsani dagasi tsunanvsvdvsgi nowu
segments.translation: The others just follow them. And there are other women that dance, that wear the turtle shells.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Are there quite a few of them?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᎡᎵ ᎣᏏ ᎢᎦ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᏏᏛ ᎠᎾᏕᎳᏆ. ᏃᎴ ᎠᏂᏲᏁᎩ ᏍᏊ ᏩᏂ ᎠᏁᏙᎰ ᎤᎾᏚᎵᎲ ᎤᎾᏕᎳᏆᏍᏗ ᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏛ
segments.transliteration: eli osi iga anehi, sidv anadelaqua. nole aniyonegi squu wani anedoho unadulihv unadelaquasdi sgi nusdv
segments.translation: There are quite a few, and some are still learning. And also, White people come over there, wanting to learn things like that.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: And you all let them dance?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: And play ball on game day.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Is there --

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: –ᏍᎩᏛ ᏄᏰᏟᏗ ᎨᎵᎰ Ꭱ ᏗᎨᏲᏗ Ꮩ ᎤᏍᏗ ᏴᏫ ᏳᎷᏥ ᏳᏚᎵ ᎤᏕᎶᏆᏍᏗ
segments.transliteration: –sgidv nuyetlidi geliho e digeyodi do usdi yvwi yulutsi yuduli udeloquasdi
segments.translation: That is the reason, I think, for whatever kind of person that comes—that wants to learn.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: If not for that, you'll lose it.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: You'll lose it.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: When they play ball, do they play ball rough?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: Ꮭ ᎤᏟ Ꭱ ᎤᏍᎦᏍᏗ ᏱᎾᎾᏛᏁᎰ ᏳᏓᎭ Ᏺ ᎠᏎᏃ Ꮭ ᏍᎩᏴ ᏱᏍᏓᏯ ᏗᏁᏟᏗ ᎢᎦ ᎦᏥᏲᏎᎰ
segments.transliteration: tla utli e usgasdi yinanadvneho yudaha yo aseno tla sgiyv yisdaya dinetlidi iga gatsiyoseho
segments.translation: Not really, they can get rough sometimes. But I tell them, you don’t have to play that hard.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Just normal.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᎣᏍᏚ, ᎠᏂᎨᏯ ᎮᏂ ᏧᏃᏰᏂᏭ ᏓᏅᏗᎰ -ᎠᏂᏍᎦᏯ ᏃᏭ ᏗᎳᏍᎦᎵᏙᏗ. ᎤᏬᏢᏗᎭ Ꮫ ᏓᎾᏁᎶᎲᏍᎪ ᏍᏆᏞᏍᏗ ᏓᏂᎦᎳᏫᏐ ᏍᎩᎾ
segments.transliteration: osdu, anigeya heni tsunoyeniwu danvdiho -anisgaya nowu dilasgalidodi. uwotlvdiha dv dananelohvsgo squatlesdi danigalawiso sgina
segments.translation: Just normal. The women use their hands, and the men use ball sticks. They play ball, all in fun, and joke around.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Do they just decide when to stop, or what?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: yeah, ᏳᏁᎵᏐᏭ ᏳᏂᏑᎵᎪᏍᏗ. Ꮎ ᎮᏂ ᎠᎭᏂ ᎨᏛ Ꮎ ᎾᏭ ᎠᏥᎳ ᏗᎲ ᏯᏂᏍᏛᏅᏅᎩ ᏍᏆᏞᏍᏗᏅ ᎣᎩᏢᏅ Ꭿ ᏱᎩᏗ. ᏍᎩᎾ ᏳᏅᏂᎳ -ᏅᎩ ᏓᏅᏎᏍᏗᎰ. ᎡᎳᏗ ᏗᏝ ᏳᏩᏂᎵ ᏌᏭ. ᎤᎾ ᏓᏂᏍᏛᏅᏅᏍᎪ–
segments.transliteration: yeah, yunelisowu yunisuligosdi. na heni ahani gedv na nawu atsila dihv yanisdvnvnvgi squatlesdinv ogitlvnv hi yigidi. sgina yunvnila -nvgi danvsesdiho. eladi ditla yuwanili sawu. una danisdvnvnvsgo–
segments.translation: Yes, just when they decide when to stop. Where the pole is, here, and where the fire is, they will draw a line. We have a ball up there this big [gestures] and when they hit that they count it four—it if it hits below that, it’s one. They draw lines there for --

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: -- What their score is?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: Yes, and when they turn around and come back, they have won.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Oh, so there are lines there?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: Yes, there are lines, where they draw lines.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.text: ᎮᏍᏕ ᏯᏩᏅᏖ ᎾᎾᏛᏁᎲ ᎠᏂᏅᏍᎬ. ᎾᎮᏂ ᏧᏲᎱᏒ ᏕᏥᎦᏘ ᎤᎾᏓᏢᎦ ᎩᎳ ᏗᎾᏛᏍᎦ ᏍᎩᎾ ᎠᎾᏁᏦᏂᏙᎰ Fayetteville ᏧᏭᎾᏁᏦᏂᏙᎸ ᏫᏕᎦᎦᏙᏍᏛᏅ. ᎯᎢᏂ Ꮠ ᎧᎴᏍᏗ ᏧᎾᏛᏅ Ꮫ ᏍᏊ Ft. Smith ᎤᏔᎾ tournament ᏛᏍᏆᎸ ᎤᎾ ᏛᏲᏤᏏ ᏣᎾᏗᎲ ᏔᎵᏍᎪ Ꮫ ᎯᏍᎩ ᏯᏂ ᎨᎵ ᎠᏁᎵᏛ ᏣᎾᏗᎲ Mississippi ᏗᏝ ᏂᏓᏳᎾᏂᎩᏓ ᏥᏈᏍᏓ ᏣᎾᏗᎲ. ᏍᎩᎮᏂ Ᏺ ᎤᏍᎦᎮᏗ ᏛᎾᏁᏦᏂ Ᏺ
segments.transliteration: hesde yawanvte nanadvnehv aninvsgv. naheni tsuyohusv detsigati unadatlvga gila dinadvsga sgina ananetsonidoho Fayetteville tsuwunanetsonidolv widegagadosdvnv. hiini so kalesdi tsunadvnv dv squu Ft. Smith utana tournament dvsqualv una dvyotsesi tsanadihv talisgo dv hisgi yani geli anelidv tsanadihv Mississippi ditla nidayunanigida tsiquisda tsanadihv. sgiheni yo usgahedi dvnanetsoni yo
segments.translation: I didn’t know what they did to score, over at Belfonte, where I pastor. There’s a group of young people, they go around playing ball. They went and played at Fayetteville, and I went and watched them. They also said this next month in Fort Smith there is going to be a big tournament and they are going, they said. They said there are 25 teams, I think, are involved. They were saying. They said a lot of them are from Mississippi. Boy they are going to have a rough ballgame.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.translation: Is it stickball Charlie?

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Yes.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.text: ᎦᏥᎦᏙᏍᏛ Ꮎ ᏙᏳ ᏍᏊ ᏍᎦᏍᏗ ᏱᎾᏅᏛᎩ ᎢᎦᏓ ᏙᎭ
segments.transliteration: gatsigadosdv na doyu squu sgasdi yinanvdvgi igada doha
segments.translation: I was watching them. Some can really play rough, ain’t it?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ‘ᏍᎦᏍᏗ ᏱᎾᎾ,ᏛᎦ, ᎮᏍᏗ,’Ꭱ ᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏲᎨᏙᎶ ᎠᏴ,
segments.transliteration: ‘sgasdi yinana,dvga, hesdi,’e sgi nusdv yogedolo ayv,
segments.translation: They can play rough. We don’t go to places like that.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: You don’t?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᎲᎥ, ᏴᏓᎭ Ꮓ ᎠᏂᏧᏥ ᎠᎾᏖᎳᏗᏍᎪ ᎠᎭᏂ ᏳᏂᏍᏆᎸᎡᎵ Ꮎ Cherokee holiday Ꮎ man to man ᎨᎵ ᏥᏓᏃᎮᎰ. ᎢᎦᏗ ᎠᎾᏖᎳᏗᏍᎪ ᎠᏂᏧᏥ
segments.transliteration: hvv, yvdaha no anitsutsi anateladisgo ahani yunisqualveli na Cherokee holiday na man to man geli tsidanoheho. igadi anateladisgo anitsutsi
segments.translation: No. Sometimes them boys join in, when they have an event here at the Cherokee Holiday. Man-to-man, I think they call it. Some of the boys join in.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.text: Ꮎ Ꮫ Ᏺ Ꮎ Mississippi ᏂᏛᏳᏂᎶᏒ ᏍᏗᎩᏗ Ꮎ ᎤᏁᏳᏥᏗ ᏥᎨᏐ ᏳᏍᏗ ᏓᏂᏃᎮᏍᎪ
segments.transliteration: na dv yo na Mississippi nidvyunilosv sdigidi na uneyutsidi tsigeso yusdi daninohesgo
segments.translation: Those that come from Mississippi, seems like—from the way they talk about them—they get mad easily.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: Yeah.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.text: ᎩᎳᏫᏴ ᏍᏓᏯ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏳᎾᏓᏛᏗ ᎠᎾᏗᎰ. ᏝᏅ ᏯᏩᏅᏘ Ꮩ ᏱᎩ
segments.transliteration: gilawiyv sdaya gohusdi yunadadvdi anadiho. tlanv yawanvti do yigi
segments.translation: Quickly, they will do something hard to you, they say. I don’t know if it's true.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᏳᎾᏓᏛᏂᏍᏙᏓ ᎾᎯᏳ ᏳᎾᏓᏍᏆᎸᏂᎳᎴ ᏱᎩ, ‘Ᏺ ... ᏳᏂᎿᎸᎪ ᎩᎳᏭ ᏱᎪᎯᏓ
segments.transliteration: yunadadvnisdoda nahiyu yunadasqualvnilale yigi, ‘yo ... yunihnalvgo gilawu yigohida
segments.translation: If they run into you, or hit you in the head, they would get mad real quick.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Did you play when you were a young man?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᎥᎥ, Ꮎ ᏦᎪᏢ – ᏄᏍᏛ ᎬᏪᏙᎸ ᏗᏪᏙᎸ
segments.transliteration: vv, na tsogotlv – nusdv gvwedolv diwedolv
segments.translation: Yeah. Just where we have it, I’ve just been there.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Do you all have a big feast, when y'all meet?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: Yeah.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: When you all meet?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᎥᎥ … ᏃᎴ Ꮎ ᏗᎳᏍᎦᎵᏗ ᏓᏃᏎᎰ Ꮎ ball sticks ᏗᎳᏍᎦᎵᏗ ᎮᏂ ᏓᏃᏎᎰ
segments.transliteration: vv … nole na dilasgalidi danoseho na ball sticks dilasgalidi heni danoseho
segments.translation: Yes, and also ball sticks they call them. Dilasgvtlvdodi, that’s what they call them, we make them ourselves.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Is that what they call them?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: We make our own.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: So y’all don’t buy the ones you use?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: No.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.text: ᎢᎦ ᎾᎮ ᏍᏊ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏚᏂᎦᏩᏟᏗ ᏙᎭ
segments.transliteration: iga nahe squu galvladi dunigawatlidi doha
segments.translation: I bet they cost a lot.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: They do.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.text: ᏌᏊ ᎮᏂ Ꮎ ᎠᏧᏥ ᎤᎾ ᏧᏲᎱᏒ ᏍᎪᎯᏍᏈ ᏕᎦᏈ ᏣᏗᎲ ᏥᏕᎦᏂᏙᎲ
segments.transliteration: saquu heni na atsutsi una tsuyohusv sgohisqui degaqui tsadihv tsideganidohv
segments.translation: One boy, at Belfonte, said he paid $100 for the ones he had.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: boy Ꮎ ᎪᎯ ᏥᏂᏃᎮᏍᎬ Ꮎ sale ᏥᏄᏅᏃ ᏥᏓᏢ ᏔᎵ ᏥᏓᎩᏩᏒ ᏑᏓᎵᏍᎪ ᎢᏅ ᏥᏓᏩᏈᏴᎲ ᏌᏭᎭ
segments.transliteration: boy na gohi tsininohesgv na sale tsinunvno tsidatlv tali tsidagiwasv sudalisgo inv tsidawaquiyvhv sawuha
segments.translation: Boy… What we were talking about a while ago—where they have that sale, there were two on there. I bought them. I paid $60 a piece for them. They are good. I wonder who made them.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Oh.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᎢᎦᏅ ᏍᏊ ᏧᏖᏗ ᎦᎪ ᏧᏬᏢᏅ ᎨᎮ
segments.transliteration: iganv squu tsutedi gago tsuwotlvnv gehe
segments.translation: They were really good. I wonder who made them?

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Are they long?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: Yeah, they are long.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.text: ᎠᏯ ᎮᏂ ᏗᏍᏆᎳ ᏓᏮᏯ Ꮭ ᏯᏩᏅᏘ ᏗᏂᏲᏟ ᏧᏅᏙᏗ ᎤᏂᏰᎸ ᏱᎩ. Ꭿ Ꮲ ᏗᎬᏅᎯᏓ
segments.transliteration: aya heni disquala dawvya tla yawanvti diniyotli tsunvdodi uniyelv yigi. hi tlv digvnvhida
segments.translation: I have short ones. I don’t know, for the kids to use if they feel like it. They are this long [gestures].

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: Some use short ones.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Is that right?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᎢᎦᏗᏅ ᏗᎦᏅᎯᏓ, Ꮎ ᎮᏂ ᎠᏂᏧᏣ ᏕᎦᏥᏕᎸ. ᏥᏚᎾᏚᎸ ᏧᎾᏁᏟᏗ ᏫᏓᏂᏁᎲᎾ ᏱᎩ ᎠᏎᏭ ᏕᎦᏥᏕᎰ ᏝᏂ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏳᏰᏟᏗ ᏱᏛᎬᏂᏕᎩ ᎤᏁᏝᏅ Ꮎ ᎤᏓᏁᎸ
segments.transliteration: igadinv diganvhida, na heni anitsutsa degatsidelv. tsidunadulv tsunanetlidi widaninehvna yigi asewu degatsideho tlani gohusdi yuyetlidi yidvgvnidegi unetlanv na udanelv
segments.translation: And some use long ones. I gave them boys some when they wanted some, to play with them, for free. There’s no reason to sell them—God has provided.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.text: Ꮭ Ꮫ ᏍᏊ Ꮎ handmade ᏥᏓᏃᎮ ᏱᎨᎮ Ꮎ ᏚᏩᏍᎬ Ꮎ ᎠᏕᎳᎰᎯᏍᏗ ᎮᏅ Ꮎ machine ᎬᏔᏅ ᎨᎲ
segments.transliteration: tla dv squu na handmade tsidanohe yigehe na duwasgv na adelahohisdi henv na machine gvtanv gehv
segments.translation: Those he bought were not what they call handmade. You could tell a machine was used.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: You can tell.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: Ꮎ Ꭱ ᏌᏊ ᎦᎷᎪ Ꭱ Rocky Ford ᎨᎵ ᏓᏳᏂᎩᏗ ᎤᏛᏒ Ꮎ Mankiller ᎠᎨᏳᏥ ᎠᏂᏁᎵ ᎾᎴ ᏱᎩ Ꮎ Bearpaw ᎠᎨᏳᏥ ᎠᏂᏁᎵ ᏍᎩᏂ ᎣᏤᏲᏅ ᏧᏬᏢᏗ. ᏙᏳ ᎡᎵ ᎣᏏ ᎾᏛᏁ ᏕᎪᏢᏍᎬ
segments.transliteration: na e saquu galugo e Rocky Ford geli dayunigidi udvsv na Mankiller ageyutsi anineli nale yigi na Bearpaw ageyutsi anineli sgini otseyonv tsuwotlvdi. doyu eli osi nadvne degotlvsgv
segments.translation: You can tell. There is one that comes, I think he is from Rocky Ford, or grew up there. He is married to that Mankiller-girl, or is it married to that Bearpaw-girl? We taught him to make them. He is doing really good at making them.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Making them.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᏃᎴ ᏍᏆᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏙᎪᏢᏂ ᏍᏊ ᎣᏍᏗᏅ ᏕᎦᏰᏫᏍᎪ
segments.transliteration: nole squatlesdi yidogotlvni squu osdinv degayewisgo
segments.translation: And also, he makes [stickball] balls. He sews them well.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: What do they put inside that ball?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: He puts walnuts inside these.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Corn?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: Walnuts.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Walnuts, oh.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᏐᎯ ᎴᏱ ᏙᎪᏢᏂ ᎤᎾ Ꮓ ᏱᎪᏢᏂ. ᏧᏬᏚᏧ ᏂᏕᎬᏁᎰ. ᏗᎳᏍᎦᎵᏗ ᏍᏊ Ꮩ ᎣᏍᏗ ᏕᎪᏢᏍᎪ ᎠᏕᎶᏆ
segments.transliteration: sohi leyi dogotlvni una no yigotlvni. tsuwodutsu nidegvneho. dilasgalidi squu do osdi degotlvsgo adeloqua
segments.translation: Or, he makes them with hickory nuts, when he makes them. He makes them beautiful. He makes good ball sticks too. He is learning.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: You know how to make them too?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᏥᏕᎪᏢᏂ Ꮫ ᏥᎨᎲ, ᎯᎢᏃ ᎠᎩᏄᎸᏅ ᏓᏩᎵᏇᏅᎾᏁᎲ ᏗᏬᏰᏂ Ꮎ drawknife ᏱᎬᏗ
segments.transliteration: tsidegotlvni dv tsigehv, hiino aginulvnv dawaliquenvnanehv diwoyeni na drawknife yigvdi
segments.translation: I could make them too. But now I can’t, because my hands will start cramping if I use a drawknife [woodwork hand tool].

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.text: ᏙᏅ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎠᏓ ᎲᏗᎰ ᏍᎩᎾ ᏗᎳᏍᎦᎵᏙᏗ ᏗᎪᏢᏗ
segments.transliteration: donv usdi ada hvdiho sgina dilasgalidodi digotlvdi
segments.translation: What kind of wood do you used to make ball sticks?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: Hickory.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.translation: Hickory.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᏭ Ꮫ ᏴᎬᏗ ᏲᏚᎵ ᏍᏊ ᏂᎦ..
segments.transliteration: nigalisdiwu dv yvgvdi yoduli squu niga..
segments.translation: You could use any kind you want. If you wanted to. As long as --

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: -- Do you put them in water?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: They put them in water.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Hot?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: Yes.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Then you can bend them good?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: You can bend them good.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.text: Ꮭ ᏯᏩᏅᏘ ᎯᏲᎵᎩ ᏱᎩ Cody Noisey
segments.transliteration: tla yawanvti hiyoligi yigi Cody Noisey
segments.translation: I don’t know if you know Cody Noisey.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: Cody Noisey, I have heard of him.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: He can make those, too.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: Yeah.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.text: ᏍᎩᏂ Ᏼ ᏱᎩᏗ -ᎤᏩᏯ pipe ᎥᎾ Ꮎ ᎠᎹ ᏯᏟᏍᏗ Ꮎ ᏃᏭ ᎭᏫᎾ ᏗᏟ ᎪᏛᏍᎪ ᏍᎩᏃ –ᏧᏥᏈᏛᏅ ᎤᎾ ᏕᎦᎳᏗᏍᎪ ᏝᎦ ᎠᎹ ᎤᏗᏝᎦ ᎨᎲ ᏃᏭᏂ ᏱᏕᎦᎵ ᏓᏍᏆᏗᏍᎬ
segments.transliteration: sgini yv yigidi -uwaya pipe vna na ama yatlisdi na nowu hawina ditli godvsgo sgino –tsutsiquidvnv una degaladisgo tlaga ama uditlaga gehv nowuni yidegali dasquadisgv
segments.translation: He can make some like that. He has a pipe this big [gestures], that he pours water in. Then he builds a fire underneath it, when he bends them. He puts them in there for a little bit, while the water is hot. Then he gets them out, then bends them.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: -ᏍᎩ ᏱᏂᏛᎬᎩ Ꮎ two inch pipe ᏴᎬᏗ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᎾ ᏴᎦᎸᏗ – ᎤᏯᏅᏅ ᏴᎦᎧᏂᎥᏙ ᎤᎾ ᏱᏅᎬᏂᏗ ᎤᏬᏚᏨ ᏱᏅᎬᎩ
segments.transliteration: -sgi yinidvgvgi na two inch pipe yvgvdi osdv una yvgalvdi – uyanvnv yvgakanivdo una yinvgvnidi uwodutsv yinvgvgi
segments.translation: You can do them like that. You can use a two-inch pipe—it fits in there good. If you have a wire, you can put it on there. You can make it beautiful.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: He fixes them good.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: That’ll be good.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: …But not all the time, just sometimes.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: Ꮎ ᎮᏂ ᏍᏊ Ꮭ ᏯᏩᏅᏘ ᎯᏲᎵᎦ Ꮎ Tommy ᎤᏪᏥ ᎠᏧᏥ Nathan ᏣᏃᏎᎰ
segments.transliteration: na heni squu tla yawanvti hiyoliga na Tommy uwetsi atsutsi Nathan tsanoseho
segments.translation: And also, I don’t know if you know Tommy's son? They call him Nathan.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Yes.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: He makes them.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: He makes them too?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: Tommy also makes them.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: What about Tommy, how is he doing?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᏙᏳ ᏍᏊ Ꮭ ᏯᏩᏅᏘ Ᏼ ᎦᏥᎪᎥ. ᎡᎵᏭ Ꮓ ᎯᎸᏍᎩ ᏄᏒ. ᎠᏭ ᎮᏅ Flute Springs Ꮲ -ᏫᎦᏁᎵ
segments.transliteration: doyu squu tla yawanvti yv gatsigov. eliwu no hilvsgi nusv. awu henv Flute Springs tlv -wiganeli
segments.translation: I can't remember when I saw him. It's been a while ago. He lives over there by Flute Springs.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Is he married?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᎤᏓᎵᏛ, ᏱᏓᏥᏲᏎ ᎮᏅ ᏳᏓᎭ ᏧᏪᏙᎲ. ᏍᎩ ᎮᏂ ᎢᎦ ᎤᎸᏈᏗ ᎨᎲ ᎤᏁᏦᏗ. ᏍᎦᏍᏗ -- Ꭱ ᏗᏟᏙ ᏥᎨᎲ
segments.transliteration: udalidv, yidatsiyose henv yudaha tsuwedohv. sgi heni iga ulvquidi gehv unetsodi. sgasdi -- e ditlido tsigehv
segments.translation: He is married. If he gets let go, he would sometimes come over there. He used to really like to play. He would be running around pretty hard.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.text: ᎣᏍᏗ ᏛᏲ Ꮎ in shape ᏣᎾᏗ ᏲᎵᏍᏙᏗ ᏱᏛᏴᏁᏦᏂ ᏍᎩᎾ
segments.transliteration: osdi dvyo na in shape tsanadi yolisdodi yidvyvnetsoni sgina
segments.translation: You should be, as they say: ‘In shape’, if you are going to play, ain’t it?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᏙᏅ, ᏣᏥᏰᏢᎸ ᎮᏂ Ꭿ ᏄᏍᏛ Ꮭ ᏯᏩᏅᏘ ᏳᏍᏗ ᏄᎵᏍᏓᏁᎲ Ꭱ hernia ᏱᎩ Ꮭ ᏯᏩᏘ ᏍᎦᏍᏗ ᏄᏩᏁᎰ ᏣᏗᎲ
segments.transliteration: donv, tsatsiyetlvlv heni hi nusdv tla yawanvti yusdi nulisdanehv e hernia yigi tla yawati sgasdi nuwaneho tsadihv
segments.translation: Really. He had surgery right here [gestures]. I don’t know what was happening to him. Maybe a hernia, I don’t know. It really hurts him, he was saying.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.text: ᎾᎾᎲ ᎬᏯᏛᏛᎭ Ꮎ ᏥᎩᏂᎸᏉᏗ ᏱᎩᏂᏛᏅᏗ Ꮎ auction ᏥᎩᏁᏓᏍᏗ ᎭᎳᏴ Ꮲ ᏍᎩ –ᎾᏛᏁᎰ?
segments.transliteration: nanahv gvyadvdvha na tsiginilvquodi yiginidvnvdi na auction tsiginedasdi halayv tlv sgi –nadvneho?
segments.translation: What about, I am going to ask you—me and you like going to the auction. How long have you been doing that?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᎡᎵ ᎠᏯ ᎯᏍᎩ Ꮲ ᎾᏕᏘᏱ ᎬᏩᎴᏅᎲ
segments.transliteration: eli aya hisgi tlv nadetiyi gvwalenvhv
segments.translation: It's been about five years since I started.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: What happened when you started?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᎠᎩᎸᏉᏛᏁ ᏛᎮ ᎠᏪᏓᏍᏗ ᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏛ. ᏃᎴ ᏴᏫ ᏕᎦᎵᏃᎮᏛ ᏙᏣᏝᏃᎮᏍᎬ ᎬᎩᏛᏛᎲᏍᎬ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ. ᏃᎴ ᎣᏍᏓ ᏯᎩᏩᏛ ᏱᎩ ᎠᎩᏩᏍᎪ ᏥᎨᎲ. ᎯᏃ ᏍᏗᎩᏗ Ꮩ ᎾᏮᎾ ᏓᏩᎵᏏᏅᏓ ᎠᏕᎳ ᏍᏗ
segments.transliteration: agilvquodvne dvhe awedasdi sgi nusdv. nole yvwi degalinohedv dotsatlanohesgv gvgidvdvhvsgv gohusdi. nole osda yagiwadv yigi agiwasgo tsigehv. hino sdigidi do nawvna dawalisinvda adela sdi
segments.translation: I guess I just started to, like, going to that. And talking to people. And just talking, and them asking me things. And if I found something good, I would buy it. But now I have slowed down a little. I'm saving a little money.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.text: Ꮎ Ꮫ Ᏺ saddle ᏥᏣᏩᏒ Ᏺ ᏙᏳ ᎣᏍᏗ. ᎠᏯ ᎮᏂ ᏱᏗᎩᎾᏟᏴᎮ ᏱᎨᏙᎮ
segments.transliteration: na dv yo saddle tsitsawasv yo doyu osdi. aya heni yidiginatliyvhe yigedohe
segments.translation: That saddle you bought was good. I would have challenged you if I was there.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: It was a beautiful saddle.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.text: ᏙᏛ Ᏺ ᎠᏤ saddle ᏑᏓᎵᏍᎪ ᎯᏍᎩ Ꭷ ᏣᏈᏴᎲ?
segments.transliteration: dodv yo atse saddle sudalisgo hisgi ka tsaquiyvhv?
segments.translation: It really was a new saddle. You paid $65 for it, ain’t it?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: Yeah $65.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: A new saddle.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: Ꮭ ᏍᏊ ᎠᎩᏛᏅ ᏱᎩ ᏙᏱ ᏗᏢ ᎠᎩᏝ
segments.transliteration: tla squu agidvnv yigi doyi ditlv agitla
segments.translation: I haven’t even used it. I have it on the porch.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.text: ᎥᎥ Ꮩ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎯᎢ ᏳᏍᏗ ᏱᎬᏗ ᎯᎢ ᏳᏍᏗ ᏛᎩᏴᎵ ᎮᎵᏍᎪᏍ ᏱᏤᎾ?
segments.transliteration: vv do usdi hii yusdi yigvdi hii yusdi dvgiyvli helisgos yitsena?
segments.translation: Do you think, “I can use this. Or, what am I going to look for?” When you go?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᏍᎩᏛ ᏂᎨᎵᎰ ᏯᏪᎾ. ᏍᏗ ᎴᏱᎩ ᏧᎦᏩᏟᏗ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏯᎩᏩ ᏱᎨᎵᎰ ᎠᏎᏃ Ꮭ ᏍᏗ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏧᎬᏩᏟᏗ ᏱᎨᎰ ᏂᎦᏓ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ
segments.transliteration: sgidv nigeliho yawena. sdi leyigi tsugawatlidi gohusdi yagiwa yigeliho aseno tla sdi gohusdi tsugvwatlidi yigeho nigada gohusdi
segments.translation: That is what I'm thinking when I go. I think “I might buy something that costs a little.” But nothing costs just a little bit.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.text: ᏙᏳ Ꮫ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏱᎾᏅᎩ ᏙᎭ Ꮎ ᎠᏂᏲᏁᎦ
segments.transliteration: doyu dv galvladi yinanvgi doha na aniyonega
segments.translation: They will make it high, ain’t it, them White people.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: They will raise it up.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.text: ᏯᏴᎯᎶᏥ ᎮᏂ ᏳᏓᎭ Ꮎ Robert. ᎩᎶ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏄᏩᏍᎬᏂ ᏱᎩ
segments.transliteration: yayvhilotsi heni yudaha na Robert. gilo gohusdi nuwasgvni yigi
segments.translation: Robert will start griping sometimes, if nobody is buying anything.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᏫᏥᏰᏣᏍᏗᎰ ᏳᏓᎭ. ᏧᏪᏥ Ꮫ ᏍᏊ ᏙᏍᏗᏫᏗᎰ ᏫᏙᏍᏗᎾᏕᎪ ᎤᎾ. ᏥᏔᎦ ᎮᏂ ᏍᏊ ᎡᎵ ᎤᎪᏗ ᏙᏍᏗᎾᏝ
segments.transliteration: witsiyetsasdiho yudaha. tsuwetsi dv squu dosdiwidiho widosdinadego una. tsitaga heni squu eli ugodi dosdinatla
segments.translation: I laugh at him sometimes. We take eggs and sell them. We also have quite a few chickens.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Are they still laying eggs?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: yeah, ᏓᏂᎲᏍᎩ. ᎤᎾ ᏧᏚᎩᏒ ᏒᎯ Ꭿ ᏄᏩᏅᏕᎬ ᎤᏄᏩ ᎤᎾ ᏕᎦᏢ ᏧᏪᏥ
segments.transliteration: yeah, danihvsgi. una tsudugisv svhi hi nuwanvdegv unuwa una degatlv tsuwetsi
segments.translation: They are still laying eggs. She went and got some yesterday, and she had her shirt like this [gestures], ‘cause she had eggs in there.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.text: ᎣᏍᏗ Ꭸ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏫᏓᏤᏢ Ꮎ ᏒᎩ ᏝᏯᏕ ᏗᏑᏍᏙᏗ ᏙᎭ
segments.transliteration: osdi ge iyusdi widatsetlv na svgi tlayade disusdodi doha
segments.translation: Those are the best to mix with onions and polk salad.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎠᏑᏴᏗ Ꮩ ᎣᏍᏗ. ᏍᎩ ᏍᏊ ᏳᏍᏗ ᎪᎯᏴ ᏥᎩ ᏗᏂᏲᏟ Ꮭ ᏱᎬᏂᎦ ᏝᏯᏕ
segments.transliteration: sgi nusdv asuyvdi do osdi. sgi squu yusdi gohiyv tsigi diniyotli tla yigvniga tlayade
segments.translation: Yeah, they are really good to mix with that. Just like that. Children nowadays will not eat polk salad.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.translation: Ain’t it?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: Mixed with eggs.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.text: ᏣᏅᏘᏍ ᏄᏰᏟᏛᎡ ᎾᏂᎩᏍᎬᏂ ᏥᎨᎰ ᏞᏍᏕ ᎤᎾᏁᏟᏛᏅ ᏱᎩ
segments.transliteration: tsanvtis nuyetlidve nanigisgvni tsigeho tlesde unanetlidvnv yigi
segments.translation: You know the reason they don’t eat that is they haven’t tried it.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: They won’t try it.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: No, they have not tried it.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.text: ᏥᏲᎮᎲ Ꮎ ᎥᎩᎵᏏ. ᏱᏣᏁᏟᏛᏁ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏱᎸᏉᏗ ᏥᏲᎮᎲ
segments.transliteration: tsiyohehv na vgilisi. yitsanetlidvne gohusdi yilvquodi tsiyohehv
segments.translation: That’s what I was telling my grandson—if you try something you will like it.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.text: Ꮎ ᎡᏲ Ꮎ ᎠᏪᏥ ᎠᎨᏳᏥ Ꮎ Cody ᏥᏥᏃᎮ ᏍᎩᎾ ᎠᏂᏁᎵ Ꮎ ᎠᏂ-Duvall ᏕᎨᏥᏴᏅᎡᎸ ᏗᏂᏲᏟ ᏍᎩᏂ ᏔᎵ ᏚᏂᎧ. ᏍᎩ Ᏺ ᏌᏭ Ꮎ ᎠᎨᏳᏥ ᏍᎦᏍᏗ ᏱᏂᎬᎦ Ꮎ ᏝᏯᏕ Ᏺ ᎠᏭ Ꮫ ᏱᎬᏁᎵ ᏯᎩ Ᏺ ᎠᎩᏍᎪ Ᏺ
segments.transliteration: na eyo na awetsi ageyutsi na Cody tsitsinohe sgina anineli na ani-Duvall degetsiyvnvelv diniyotli sgini tali dunika. sgi yo sawu na ageyutsi sgasdi yinigvga na tlayade yo awu dv yigvneli yagi yo agisgo yo
segments.translation: Now, my daughter—the one that is married to Cody. I was talking [with her] about some children that were taken away from them Duvall’s. And they have two [of those children] now. One girl will really eat that polk salad. She will eat it like this when she eats it [gestures].

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: It's good to eat, that polk salad.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Does your wife preserve things?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: No.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: She doesn’t?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: She puts it in the deep freeze.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.text: Ꭳ, ᏥᏈᏍᏗᏛ ᎣᏍᏓ ᏍᎩ ᏱᎬᏂᏗ. ᎾᎮᏂ ᎠᎩᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎩ ᏒᎩ ᏍᎩ ᏂᎬᏁᎰ freezerᎢ ᎦᏢᏍᎪ
segments.transliteration: o, tsiquisdidv osda sgi yigvnidi. naheni agisdayvhvsgi svgi sgi nigvneho freezeri gatlvsgo
segments.translation: You can do lots of good things like that. My wife does onions like that, she puts it in the freezer.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: freezer, -ᎾᎮᏂ ᏍᏊ Ꮎ ᏆᏂ indian peaches -ᎠᎩᎧ ᏌᏊ ᎤᏬᏚᏨ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᏂᏥᎸ ᏂᎬ ᏥᏈᏍᏙᏒ ᎠᎮ ᎤᎾᏛᏖᏍᏗ Ꭿ ᎪᎩ
segments.transliteration: freezer, -naheni squu na quani indian peaches -agika saquu uwodutsv nusdv unitsilv nigv tsiquisdosv ahe unadvtesdi hi gogi
segments.translation: In the freezer. And, also peaches. I have one Indian peach plant, it has beautiful blooms everywhere. It is going to have lots of fruit on it this summer.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: That frost didn’t kill them?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: I don’t think so.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.text: ᎠᏯ Ꮫ Ᏺ ᏆᏄᏂᏍᏗ boy ᎢᎦ ᎣᏍᏓ ᎾᎵᏍᏗᎰ ᎤᏂᎦᎾᏍᏗ ᏍᎩ Ᏺ ᏕᎨᏥᎷᎩ Ᏺ
segments.transliteration: aya dv yo quanunisdi boy iga osda nalisdiho uniganasdi sgi yo degetsilugi yo
segments.translation: For me it was plums. Boy they really do good. They were really sweet, but it killed them.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᎪᎯᎦ -- ᏖᏚ ᎮᏂ ᏍᏊ ᏣᎩᏑᎳᎪᏣ ᏓᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ Ꮎ Greenleaf ᎤᏂᏥᎸᏍᎩ ᏧᎾᏛᎯᏍᏙᏗ twenty nine years ᎦᏥᏍᏕᎸᎲ ᎤᎾ
segments.transliteration: gohiga -- tedu heni squu tsagisulagotsa dagilvwisdanehv na Greenleaf unitsilvsgi tsunadvhisdodi twenty nine years gatsisdelvhv una
segments.translation: It wasn’t long ago I quit working at Greenleaf—where they raise flowers. I helped them for 29 years.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: You worked there?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᎥᎥ, ᏧᎩᏨᏅᏓ Ꮫ ᏔᎵ ᏧᏕᏘᏳᏗ ᎦᏥᏍᏕᎸᎲ Ꮎ ᏗᏍᏙᏰᎲ ᏱᎩ Ꮎ
segments.transliteration: vv, tsugitsvnvda dv tali tsudetiyudi gatsisdelvhv na disdoyehv yigi na
segments.translation: Yes, every day. I helped them for two years. ‘Like on trimming.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Yourself, or with a machine?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᎲᎥ, -- machine ᎾᎡ ᏍᏊ Ꮎ chainsaw ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏔᎵ ᏧᏕᏘᏴᏗ ᏣᎩᏛᏅ. ᏃᎴ ᏥᏓᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ Ꮭ ᏱᎬᏌᎳᏓᏁᎮ. “hey” ᎦᏙᏅ ᎤᏰᏟᏗ Ꭿ ᏥᏂᏛᏁ ᏥᏍᎩᏯᎧᎲᏏᏙ ᎦᏥᏲᎮᎲ ᎤᏣᏘᏂ ᏗᏝ ᎤᎬᎩᎧᎲᏍᎬ ᏃᎴ - ᎪᎱᏍᏗ Ꮫ ᎤᏰᏟᏗ ᎠᏬᎮᎸ Ꮎ ᏌᏊ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ. Ꮶ ᏄᏕᏘᏴ Ꮓ -ᏩᏩᎴᏅ Ꮓ ᏓᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᏗᎧᏍᏟ Ꮓ ᏧᎬᎩᎧᎾ ᎤᎾ Ꮓ ᏫᎬᎩᏌᎳᏓᏁᎸ
segments.transliteration: hvv, -- machine nae squu na chainsaw iyusdi tali tsudetiyvdi tsagidvnv. nole tsidagilvwisdanehv tla yigvsaladanehe. “hey” gadonv uyetlidi hi tsinidvne tsisgiyakahvsido gatsiyohehv utsatini ditla ugvgikahvsgv nole - gohusdi dv uyetlidi awohelv na saquu asgaya. tso nudetiyv no -wawalenv no dagilvwisdanehv dikastli no tsugvgikana una no wigvgisaladanelv
segments.translation: Yourself, but with a machine—kind of like a chainsaw, I used it for two years. I was working for a while, and they weren't giving me a raise. I said, “Hey what’s the reason I’m doing this? You all are moving me around.” They would put me in a different spot. That one man told me the reason. After three years they put me as the boss, then they gave me a raise.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: I guess they were preparing for that, when they were moving you around.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᎾᎡ ᏕᏡᎬ ᎣᏍᏓ ᏥᏳᎪᏗ ᏂᏙᏨᏁᎲ bucket-ᎢᏛ ᏚᏂᎲ stakes ᏙᏥᏛᏍᎬ ᏙᏥᎧᏁᎯᎲ ... ᏥᏳᎪᏗᎡ ᏗᎦᏙᎬ ᏥᎨᎲ ᎾᎮᎾ Ꮭ ᏯᏩᏅᏔ ᏳᏍᏗ ᎨᎲ Ꮎ ᏗᎩᎦᎨ ᎠᏓ overseas ᏙᏓᏳᏂᎩᏓ ᏙᏤᏛᏍᎬ ᏙᏳ,’Ꮽ ᎯᎢ ᏗᏯᏖᎾ
segments.transliteration: nae detlugv osda tsiyugodi nidotsvnehv bucket-idv dunihv stakes dotsidvsgv dotsikanehihv ... tsiyugodie digadogv tsigehv nahena tla yawanvta yusdi gehv na digigage ada overseas dodayunigida dotsedvsgv doyu,’wu hii diyatena
segments.translation: We made the trees straight, that were in a bucket. We would put stakes and tie them. They would be standing up straight. I don’t know what kind they were. They were red wood that came from overseas. We would stand them up, they were really just this wide [gestures].

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: There was a reason they went and got them that far.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᎤᎸᏗᎯᏗ ᎨᎲ Ꮎ Texas ᎡᎯ ᎤᎷᏨ Ꮎ ᏍᎦᏍᏗ ᏥᏰᏣᏍᏛ Ꭱ ᎠᎨ ᎤᎾᏚᎵ ᎨᏣᎪᏩᏛᏗ ᎤᏛᎾ Ꮎ ᏧᎧᏍᎵ ᏩᎩᎷᏨ Ꮩ ᎤᏍᏗ ᏥᏲᏎᎸ. ᎯᎠ ᏥᏂᏕᏨᏂ ᎦᏙ ᎤᏰᏟᏗ ᎠᏬᎮᎸ Ꮎ five ᎯᏍᎩ ᏱᎦᏗ ᏓᏪᏛ stake ᎯᏍᎩᏅ ᏗᎧᏁᏍᏗ ᎨᎲ ᎯᏭ ᏳᏓᎵ ᏥᏳᎩᏗ ᏂᏕᎦᎵᏍᏗᎲ ᏍᎩᏃ ᏥᏃᏎᎲ ᎤᏍᏗ ᏄᏰᏟᏛ. ᏍᏈᏯ Ꮫ ᏕᏣᎧᏁ ᎠᏬᎮᎸ. ᏙᏛᎮ Ꮭ ᏱᎨᎵ ᏥᏲᎮᎸ ᏍᏗᎩᏗ ᏦᎩᎾᏘᏲᎯᏍᏛᏅ ᏳᏍᏗ. ᏂᎾ ᎭᎳᎩ ᏕᎯᎧᏁᎯᎰ ᏥᏲᎮᎸ? Ꭽ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏳᏛᏁ ᎡᎾ Texas ᏙᏗᏳᏂᎩᏓ --ᏚᏂᎧᎲ ᏆᏂ ᏕᎦᏛᏅᎬᏭ Ꮫ ᎾᏅ ᎠᏯ ᎣᏍᏓ ᏲᎬᏁᎳ ᏥᏳᎪᏓ ᏕᎦᏙᎬ Ꭱ ᎭᏰᎵᏍᏓ ᎠᎩᎸᎲ ᎨᏛ ᎢᏡᎬ ᎨᏛ ᎤᏬᏚᏨ ᏄᏍᏛ. ᏂᎦᏓ ᎾᏮᏅᏕᏒ Ꮎ tape ᎤᏬᏚᏨ ᎦᏙᎬ Ꮎ ᎢᏡᎬ
segments.transliteration: ulvdihidi gehv na Texas ehi ulutsv na sgasdi tsiyetsasdv e age unaduli getsagowadvdi udvna na tsukasli wagilutsv do usdi tsiyoselv. hia tsinidetsvni gado uyetlidi awohelv na five hisgi yigadi dawedv stake hisginv dikanesdi gehv hiwu yudali tsiyugidi nidegalisdihv sgino tsinosehv usdi nuyetlidv. squiya dv detsakane awohelv. dodvhe tla yigeli tsiyohelv sdigidi tsoginatiyohisdvnv yusdi. nina halagi dehikanehiho tsiyohelv? ha gohusdi yudvne ena Texas dodiyunigida --dunikahv quani degadvnvgvwu dv nanv aya osda yogvnela tsiyugoda degadogv e hayelisda agilvhv gedv itlugv gedv uwodutsv nusdv. nigada nawvnvdesv na tape uwodutsv gadogv na itlugv
segments.translation: They were hard. There was a man from Texas—I was really laughing at him. The boss said “They want to see you over there.” I went over there and I said, “What is it?” He said, “How y’all have these? What is the reason?” “I had driven stakes that were five foot tall. And you had to tie it five times, just this far [gestures] so they got straight,” that’s what I told him the reason was. “You have tied them too many times”, he told me. “I really don’t think so," I told him. We kind of got into an argument. I said, “What about you, how many times do you tie it?” He didn’t say anything. They had a peach plant that came from Texas. They were just falling down, and the ones we fixed were standing straight up. I got my knife out and there was a beautiful tree standing there, and I took all the tape off that tree. It was standing beautifully.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Without it being tied?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᎾᎧᏁᎲᎾ, ᏥᏰᏛᎩᏒ. Ꭿ Ꮫ ᏱᏂᏚᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᏱᏂᏗᎬᏕᏏ ᏥᏲᎮᎲ. ᏭᎵᏍᏛᏂᎸ pick up ᏭᏣᏅ ᎤᏓᎾᏫᏍᏛᏅ ft smith, ft gibson ᎮᏂ ᏍᏊ ᏧᎦᏥᏍᏕᎵᎲ ᏳᏓᎭ
segments.transliteration: nakanehvna, tsiyedvgisv. hi dv yinidusdesdi yinidigvdesi tsiyohehv. wulisdvnilv pick up wutsanv udanawisdvnv ft smith, ft gibson heni squu tsugatsisdelihv yudaha
segments.translation: Without it being tied. I pulled it [the stake] out. They will be like this if you take them off, I told him. He shook his head, got in his pickup and took off. I would go help them in Fort Smith or Fort Gibson sometimes.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.text: ᎮᏍᏗ Ꮫ Ꭺ ᏥᏂᎩ ᏱᏂᎨ ᎾᎯᏳ Ᏺ ᏥᏕᏣᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ
segments.transliteration: hesdi dv go tsinigi yinige nahiyu yo tsidetsalvwisdanehv
segments.translation: It wasn’t as big as it is now, when you were working there.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᎲᎥ, ᎾᎮᏂ Greenleaf ᏣᏃᎮᎲ ᎦᏚᏏ ᏗᏝ Ꮭ ᏯᏩᏅᏘ ᏂᎦᏓ ᏳᏂᏩᏒ ᏠᎨᏌ Ꭿ ᏗᏝ. ᎤᎾ ᏃᏭ ᎪᏢᏒ ᏣᎾᏗ ᏥᎬᏬᏎᎲ. ᏧᎾᏚᎵᎲ ᎮᏂ -ᏫᎦᏥᏍᏕᏟᏗ. Ꮩ ᏛᎮ Ꮭ -ᏱᏂᎦᎦᏛᎩ ᎪᎯᎢᎦ ᏥᎩ ᎦᏥᏲᎮᎲ ᏃᎴ ᎠᏩᏨᏏᏰᏗ -- ᎠᏩᏨᏏᏰᎢᏓᏍᏗ ᎠᎩᏄᎸᎲᏍᎪ
segments.transliteration: hvv, naheni Greenleaf tsanohehv gadusi ditla tla yawanvti nigada yuniwasv tlogesa hi ditla. una nowu gotlvsv tsanadi tsigvwosehv. tsunadulihv heni -wigatsisdetlidi. do dvhe tla -yinigagadvgi gohiiga tsigi gatsiyohehv nole awatsvsiyedi -- awatsvsiyeidasdi aginulvhvsgo
segments.translation: No. Where they call it Greenleaf on the hill, I don’t know if they bought that whole field on this side. There was a place there, too, they were telling me. They wanted me to go back and help them. I told them I really can't do it anymore. And walking, I can't hardly walk around.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.text: ᎾᏛᏅ Ꮎ ᎠᏂ beaver ᏥᏓᏂᏁᎸ ᎤᎾ ᎣᏂ ᏗᏟ ᏙᎭ? ᏍᎩᏅ ᎤᏂᏩᏎ ᏍᎩ’Ꮓ ᎠᏂᏁᏉᎬ ᎨᏒ
segments.transliteration: nadvnv na ani beaver tsidaninelv una oni ditli doha? sginv uniwase sgi’no aninequogv gesv
segments.translation: It’s behind where the Beavers used to live, ain’t it? They bought that and now are expanding it.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: It ends by the water.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: It ends that far now?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᎠᎭᏂ ᏍᏊ ᎯᎠ ᏗᏝ ᎨᎵ ᎤᏂᏩᏎ ᎤᏴᏢ ᏗᏝ ᏣᏅᏛᏅ Ꮩ ᏚᏙ Ꮎ ᏧᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ ᎦᏚᏏ ᏥᎪᏢ? ᎤᎾ ᎾᎥ --gravel road ᏧᎦᏅᎾ
segments.transliteration: ahani squu hia ditla geli uniwase uyvtlv ditla tsanvdvnv do dudo na tsunalisdayvdi gadusi tsigotlv? una nav --gravel road tsuganvna
segments.translation: And on this side, I think they bought it, too. On the north side. Do you know that… What's the name of that restaurant on the hill? There, near that gravel road?

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Yeah.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᎤᎾ ᏱᏫᏣᎶᏏ. ᏗᎦᎾᏗᏫᏒ ᏗᏝ ᎤᎾ ᏂᎦᏓ ᎤᏂᏩᏎ ᏣᎾᏗᎲ
segments.transliteration: una yiwitsalosi. diganadiwisv ditla una nigada uniwase tsanadihv
segments.translation: If you go by there. Go that way, across from there. They bought all of that, they said.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: It's still going to get bigger.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: Yeah, they have buildings way over there.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.text: ᎠᏂᏍᏆᏂ Ꮫ ᏍᏊ Ꮓ ᎠᏂᎧᎵ ᏙᎭ
segments.transliteration: anisquani dv squu no anikali doha
segments.translation: It's full of Mexicans now, ain’t it?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: That’s it.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: They pay them less.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: No.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: No?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᎤᎪᏗᏅ ᏓᏅᎾᏈᏴᎡ ᏏᏅ Ꮎ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᏏᎾ ᎠᏂᏐ ᎮᎾ. ᎾᎮᏂ -ᏔᎵᏚ ᎮᏂ ᏕᎦᏘᏁᎲ retire ᏥᎾᏩᏛᏁᎸ Ꭱ ᎤᎾ ᏠᎨᏌ ᎣᏤᏙᎲ Ꮎ ᏧᏂᎧᏍᏟ ᎬᎩᏛᏛᎲᏍᎬ Ꭱ ᎯᎢᎾ ᏥᏕᎲᏘᏁ ᏔᎵᏚ ᎾᏂ ᎠᎭᏂ ᏗᏝ ᏫᏙᏛᏲᏥᎧᏂ ᎤᏛᏅ. --ᎦᏙᏅ ᏳᏰᏟᏗ ᏍᎩ ᏱᎾᏛᏁ ᏥᏲᎮᎸ ᏄᎾᏛᎴᏛ ᏦᏍᎪ ᎨᎵ ᏛᏂᎷᏥ Ꮎ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᎾᏍᏗ ᏴᏫ ᏧᏛᏅ ᎮᏂ ᏍᎩᏃ ᏖᏲᎲᏍᎩ ᎨᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᏬᎮᎸ ᏍᎩᎾ ᏙᏖᏲᏂ ᎣᏍᏓ ᏗᎨᏛᏍᏗ ᏥᎾᏛᏁ ᎠᏬᏎᎸ. ᏙᏛ ᎠᏎ Ꮭ ᎠᏯ ᎨᎲ ᎦᏥᏲᎮᎸ ᎠᎭᏂᏭ retire ᏱᏂᎦᏛᎦ ᎪᎯᎦ ᎦᏥᏲᎮᎸ. ᎡᎵᏭ ᏃᏭ ᏂᎪᎯᎵ ᏓᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏏᏴ ᎤᎩᏨᏓ ᎮᎾ ᎨᏍᏓ ᏯᎩᎷᏥ ᏃᏭ Ꮩ ᎾᏩᏛᏁᎸ retire ᏂᏓᎦᏛᏁᎵ ᎦᏥᏲᎮᎸ. ᎾᏅ Ꮎ ᎠᏂᏐ -ᏕᎦᏘᏁᎲ ᏗᎦᏘᏂᏙᎸ two weeks ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᎢᎦᏗᏅ ᏒᏂᏙᏓᏩᏍᎩ ᏭᏂᏑᎵᎪᏦᏅ. Ꮭ ᏳᎾᏚᎵᎮ Ꮎ ᎠᏂᏍᏆᏂ ᏧᎧᏍᏟ ᎤᏂᎧᎥ ᎤᎾ ᏗᏝ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏗ. ᎾᏅ ᏍᏊ ᎣᏍᏓᏝᏅᏢ Jimmy Dean ᏣᏃᎮᎰ - ᏍᏊ ᎤᎾ ᏧᎧᏍᏟ ᏥᎨᎲ
segments.transliteration: ugodinv danvnaquiyve sinv na tsunilvwisdanehi sina aniso hena. naheni -talidu heni degatinehv retire tsinawadvnelv e una tlogesa otsedohv na tsunikastli gvgidvdvhvsgv e hiina tsidehvtine talidu nani ahani ditla widodvyotsikani udvnv. --gadonv yuyetlidi sgi yinadvne tsiyohelv nunadvledv tsosgo geli dvnilutsi na gohusdi unasdi yvwi tsudvnv heni sgino teyohvsgi gehesdi awohelv sgina doteyoni osda digedvsdi tsinadvne awoselv. dodv ase tla aya gehv gatsiyohelv ahaniwu retire yinigadvga gohiga gatsiyohelv. eliwu nowu nigohili dagilvwisdasiyv ugitsvda hena gesda yagilutsi nowu do nawadvnelv retire nidagadvneli gatsiyohelv. nanv na aniso -degatinehv digatinidolv two weeks dunilvwisdanelv igadinv svnidodawasgi wunisuligotsonv. tla yunadulihe na anisquani tsukastli unikav una ditla tsunilvwisdadi. nanv squu osdatlanvtlv Jimmy Dean tsanoheho - squu una tsukastli tsigehv
segments.translation: They pay them more than they do the other workers. I was the leader of 12 when I retired. We were out there in the field with the bosses. They were asking me, "These 12 that you are in charge of, we are going to move them over 'here.'" Then he asks, "What is the reason you are doing that?" I said to him. “Some different people are going to come. I think 30 of them. Some kind of people,” he said. “You are going to be teaching them,” he told me. “You are going to teach them to stand those up good, like you are doing.” he told me. As for me “I don’t think so,” I told him. “I can retire today,” I told him. “I have worked here long enough,” I told him. I didn’t come the next day. I quit. I told them I was going to retire. And the others, that I was leading, worked two weeks, and some a week. And [then] they quit. They didn’t want that Mexican boss that they had to work [for], over there. And my brother, the one they call Jimmy Dean—he was the boss there too.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.text: ᎥᎥ, ᏝᎦ ᎮᏂ ᏔᎵ ᏧᏕᏘᏴᏗ ᎨᎵ ᏥᏓᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸ. ᏍᎩᎾ ᏧᎧᏍᏟ ᏥᎨᎲ Ꮲ ᏗᏝ ᏝᏍᎩᏂ ᏱᎦᏅᏓᏗ ᏳᏍᏗ ᏯᏛᏁ ᏱᎨᎮ
segments.transliteration: vv, tlaga heni tali tsudetiyvdi geli tsidagilvwisdanelv. sgina tsukastli tsigehv tlv ditla tlasgini yiganvdadi yusdi yadvne yigehe
segments.translation: For a little while I worked there. I think two years—he was the boss, but I don’t remember what he did.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏚ ᏛᎮ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏯᎾᏛᏁ ᎨᎮ ᏍᎩᎾ. ᎪᎯᏕ ᎮᏂ ᏥᎦᏥᏍᏕᎸᎲ Ꮎ ᏓᏂᏍᏙᏰᏍᎬ Ꮎ basketball ᏳᏍᏗ ᏱᏗᎬᏂ ᏥᎨᎲ Ꮎ ᏗᏥᎾ. ᏍᎩ ᏳᏍᏗ ᏂᏙᏨᏁᎲ ᎭᏢ ᏣᏕᎳᏆᎡ ᎬᏬᎮᎲ? ᎠᎭᏂᏭ Ꮫ ᏯᎦᏙᏍᏗ ᏴᏫ ᎾᏛᏁᎲ ᎪᏢᏍᎬ ᎤᎾ ᏯᏕᏠᎩ ᎦᏥᏲᎮᎲ. ᏳᏓᎭ Ꮎ ᎠᏂᏍᏆᏂ ᏣᎳᎩᎭ ᏙᎦᎵᏃᎮᏗᎲ
segments.transliteration: tsudalenvdu dvhe gohusdi yanadvne gehe sgina. gohide heni tsigatsisdelvhv na danisdoyesgv na basketball yusdi yidigvni tsigehv na ditsina. sgi yusdi nidotsvnehv hatlv tsadelaquae gvwohehv? ahaniwu dv yagadosdi yvwi nadvnehv gotlvsgv una yadetlogi gatsiyohehv. yudaha na anisquani tsalagiha dogalinohedihv
segments.translation: They did just different things. For a long time, I helped them trim those basketball-like things on those evergreens. We did those. They asked me, “Where did you learn?” I said “If you just watch someone making it, you can just learn there.” Sometimes I would talk to those Mexicans in Cherokee.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Were they just looking at each other?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: They were really learning.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: They were learning?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᏣᎯᏗᏴ ᏣᎾᏕᎳᏆᏍᎬ ᏏᎾ ᎠᏁᏐ ᎨᎲ. ᏍᎦᏍᏗ ᎤᏬᎵᏗᎭ Ꮫ ᏙᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ. ᏓᏂᎦᎳᏫᏐᏍᎬ ᏧᎾᏛᎯᏍᏗ ᎮᏂ ᏳᏍᏗ ᏕᎦᏘᏁᎲ ᎠᏯ George Steele ᎯᏲᎵᎩᏍ?
segments.transliteration: tsahidiyv tsanadelaquasgv sina aneso gehv. sgasdi uwolidiha dv dogilvwisdanehv. danigalawisosgv tsunadvhisdi heni yusdi degatinehv aya George Steele hiyoligis?
segments.translation: They were learning easier than the others. It was amazing. We were having fun working. We would be joking around while I was leading older guys. George Steele, do you know him?

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Yes.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: He used to help us, too.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: How much did they pay back then?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: Ꮩ ᏥᎾᏩᏛᏁᎸ fourteen dollars an hour ᏣᏩᏈᏴᎡᎲ
segments.transliteration: do tsinawadvnelv fourteen dollars an hour tsawaquiyvehv
segments.translation: When I retired, they were paying me $14 an hour.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: So you were getting paid pretty good, ain’t it?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: Yes.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.text: ᎠᏯ ᎮᏂ ᎥᎬᏱ ᏣᏩᎴᏅᎲ dollar and a quarter ᏣᏩᏈᏴᎡᎲ ᏳᏟᎶᏗ
segments.transliteration: aya heni vgvyi tsawalenvhv dollar and a quarter tsawaquiyvehv yutlilodi
segments.translation: When I first started, they were paying me $1.25 an hour.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᎯᏍᎩ Ꮫ ᏳᏩᎦᏗ ᏥᏓᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᎤᎾ ᏝᎦ ᏃᎴ ᎥᏥᏑᎵᎪᎬ ᏃᎴ ᎥᏥᎷᎬ Ꮎ Estel Brannon ᏣᏃᎮᎰ - ᏥᏍᏕᎵᎲ
segments.transliteration: hisgi dv yuwagadi tsidagilvwisdanelv una tlaga nole vtsisuligogv nole vtsilugv na Estel Brannon tsanoheho - tsisdelihv
segments.translation: I worked there five times, for a little while. I would quit, then I would come back. The one they call Estel Brannon—I would help him.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.text: ᎠᏯ ᎮᏂ Ꮎ D.R. ᏍᎩᎾ ᏧᎧᏍᏟ ᎨᎲ. ᏃᏭᏅ Ꮩ ᏦᎩᏘᏂᏙ ᎨᎲ Ꮎ Danny - Danny Brannon ᎲᎥ Danny.. ᏙᎨ ᏥᏚᏙ? ᎠᏩᎨᏫᏒ Ꮫ ᏍᎩ ᏳᏍᏗ ᏚᏙᎥ, Danny ᎡᏲ ᏥᏚᏙᎥ ᎠᏫᏄᏥᏭ ᏥᎨᎲ
segments.transliteration: aya heni na D.R. sgina tsukastli gehv. nowunv do tsogitinido gehv na Danny - Danny Brannon hvv Danny.. doge tsidudo? awagewisv dv sgi yusdi dudov, Danny eyo tsidudov awinutsiwu tsigehv
segments.translation: For me, it was D.R—that was the boss. But our leader was Danny Brannon. No, Danny… What is his name? I can't remember what his [family] name was. But his name is Danny. He was just a young man.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: Danny… Was it Danny Fountain?

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.text: ᎲᎥ, ᏣᏅᏘ Ꮎ Eubanks ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏅᎾ ᏥᎩ
segments.transliteration: hvv, tsanvti na Eubanks unadanvnvna tsigi
segments.translation: No. You know where the Eubanks used to have that store?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: Yes.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.text: ᎡᏍᎦ ᏗᏟᏭ ᎢᏴ Ꭿ ᏗᏝ ᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᎤᎾ ᎦᏁᎵ ᎠᏩᎨᏩᏏ ᏍᎩ ᏳᏍᏗ ᏚᏙᎥ .. ᏝᏲ Brannon ᏱᎩ. Danny Brannon ᎮᏂ ᎡᏧᎵᎭ ᏦᎩᎾᏕᎳᏆᎥ Ᏺ ᏍᎩᎾ. ᎠᏎᏃ --ᎣᏍᏓ ᏍᏊ ᏥᎨᎲ
segments.transliteration: esga ditliwu iyv hi ditla adanelv una ganeli awagewasi sgi yusdi dudov .. tlayo Brannon yigi. Danny Brannon heni etsuliha tsoginadelaquav yo sgina. aseno --osda squu tsigehv
segments.translation: Just before you get there, on this side, there is a house. And he lives there. I have forgotten what his name is. It's not Brannon, because I went to school with Danny Brannon. But he was good too.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᎾᎾ Donnie Coles? ᏍᏊ ᏧᎧᏍᏟ ᏥᎨᎲ ᎤᎾ -
segments.transliteration: nana Donnie Coles? squu tsukastli tsigehv una -
segments.translation: What about Donnie Coles? He was the boss there too.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.text: ᎥᎥ .. ᎥᎥ … ᏗᏣᏛᏏᏗᏒ ᏱᏗᏣᏓᏂᎶᏏ ᎦᎾᎦᏘᏍ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᎦᏍᏕ ᏦᎨ ᎢᏨᏏᏭ ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎲ
segments.transliteration: vv .. vv … ditsadvsidisv yiditsadanilosi ganagatis itsalisgasde tsoge itsvsiwu itsigatahv
segments.translation: Yeah, yeah. When you were growing up did you all depend on the doctor, or what you all knew yourselves?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: We just used what my dad knew.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: You don’t remember some of that?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: I really don’t remember some of that.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: But you do know that it helped you all.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: Yeah.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.text: ᎾᎾᎭ ᏏᏭ auction ᏓᏥᏁᏍᏔᏂ. ᎤᎾᏭᏍ ᎢᎦ ᎮᏙᎰ ᎾᎨ Ꮲ ᏄᏓᎴᏍᏗ ᏓᏅᏁᎲ ᏪᏙᎰ?
segments.transliteration: nanaha siwu auction datsinestani. unawus iga hedoho nage tlv nudalesdi danvnehv wedoho?
segments.translation: What about, I'm going to mention that auction again. Do you just go there or do you go to a different place?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᏢᏛ ᏄᎾᏛᎴ --ᏧᏂᏍᏆᎸᎡᎲ ᏫᎨᏙᎰ ᏳᏓᎭ ᎠᎭᏂ Ꮎ Ganns ᏱᎩ. ᎤᎾ Ꮫ Ᏺ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏗ ᎠᏂᎾᏕᏒᎲᏍᎪ tractor ᏱᎩ
segments.transliteration: tlvdv nunadvle --tsunisqualvehv wigedoho yudaha ahani na Ganns yigi. una dv yo tsudalenvdi aninadesvhvsgo tractor yigi
segments.translation: I go to different places, you know like in Ganns. There they sell a lot of different things, like tractors.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Where is that at?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᏣᏅᏔ Ꮎ ᏐᏈᎵ ᏧᏂᎾᏗᏅᏗ ᏥᎨᎲ ᎪᎯᎦ?
segments.transliteration: tsanvta na soquili tsuninadinvdi tsigehv gohiga?
segments.translation: You know where they used to sell horses a long time ago?

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Yeah.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᎤᎾᏭ ᏳᏣᏕᏲᎵ ᏣᏓᎾᏅ ᎤᎾ ᏴᏞᎦ ᎨᏫᏴ ᏯᏂᎦ gravel road ᏭᏞᏍᏗ ᎤᎾ --
segments.transliteration: unawu yutsadeyoli tsadananv una yvtlega gewiyv yaniga gravel road wutlesdi una --
segments.translation: Way over there. When you go around that store. Turn there, and go a little ways, and turn on a gravel road.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: When do they have their event?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: Second Saturday.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: In the daytime?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᎢᎦ, ᏍᎪᎯ ᎨᎵ ᎠᏟᎩᎵᏒ ᏒᎾᎴ -ᏥᏔᎩ ᏓᏂᎾᏕᎩ ᏏᏆ Ꮫ ᏍᏊ ᏩᎦ ᎠᎴ ᏱᎩ ᏐᏫᎵ ᎠᎴ ᏱᎩ ᏓᏂᎾᏕᏒᎲᏍᎪ ᎤᎾ ᎠᎭᏂᏅ ᏗᏝ ᎤᏌᏛ ᏗᏝ ᏠᎨᏏ ᎤᏔᎾ ᎪᏢ ᎤᎾᏛ ᏳᏭᏂᏟᎦ ᎤᎾ tractor ᏱᎩ pickup ᎠᎴ ᏱᎩ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏓ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ Ꮎ ᏠᎨᏌ ᎬᏛᏅᏙᏗ. ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏓᏭ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ.
segments.transliteration: iga, sgohi geli atligilisv svnale -tsitagi daninadegi siqua dv squu waga ale yigi sowili ale yigi daninadesvhvsgo una ahaninv ditla usadv ditla tlogesi utana gotlv unadv yuwunitliga una tractor yigi pickup ale yigi tsudalenvda gohusdi na tlogesa gvdvnvdodi. tsudalenvdawu gohusdi.
segments.translation: In the daytime. I think at ten in the morning. I think they sell chickens. Also pigs, or cows, or horses. They sell there, on this side, in the back, towards a big field. There they will have it piled up with tractors, or pickups, and different things you use in a field. Just different things.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Do they still do it today?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: Yeah, or they sell wood or hay.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: What about in Inola, where they have that big event? Have you been there?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: I have never been there.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.text: ᎠᏯ Ᏺ ᎯᎸᏍᎩ ᏩᏪᏙᎸ. ᏅᎩᎭ ᏓᏂᎯᎵᏐ ᎠᎾᎢᏐ ᎠᏂᎾᏕᏒᎲᏍᎬ
segments.transliteration: aya yo hilvsgi wawedolv. nvgiha danihiliso anaiso aninadesvhvsgv
segments.translation: I have been there several times. They have four going at the same time selling things.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: They say it’s big there.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.text: ᎤᏔᏂ Ꮫ ᏥᏈᏍᏗ Ꮫ Ꮎ ᎤᏂᏟᎪ ᎠᎭᏂ ᏗᏝ ᏃᏅ tractor, trailer ᏲᏚᎵ Ꮫ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ Ꮫ --ᏛᏴᏩᏛ Ᏺ ᎤᎾ
segments.transliteration: utani dv tsiquisdi dv na unitligo ahani ditla nonv tractor, trailer yoduli dv gohusdi dv --dvyvwadv yo una
segments.translation: It is big. They have lots of things piled up. And on this side, they have tractors, trailers. If you want something you’re going to find it there.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: I guess as long as you got money.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.text: ᏍᎩ Ꮫ ᏱᏙᏟ Ꮫ, ᏥᏔᎦ ᏍᎩᏂ ᎧᏁᏍᎩ ᏍᎩ ᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᎾᏕᏒᎲᏍᎪ. … ᏓᏬᎵ Ꮎ ᏗᏣᎸᏉᏗᏍ?
segments.transliteration: sgi dv yidotli dv, tsitaga sgini kanesgi sgi yusdi aninadesvhvsgo. … dawoli na ditsalvquodis?
