segments.translation: If you got it, that’s right. Chickens and hay, things like that they sell. What about mushrooms? Do you like them?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: I like mushrooms.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Do you look for them?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: I can’t hardly walk in the woods.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: No you can’t do it.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: No, I can't do it.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: If someone --

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: -- I can't walk around in the woods.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: -- someone would have gave them to you, if you ate them.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᏔᎵ ᎮᏂ ᎾᏕᏘᏱ ᎠᎩᏃᎭᎸᏒ ᎠᏫ ᏓᎩᏴᎸᏒ Ꮎ ᏅᏃ ᏗᎦᎾᏗᏫᏒ ᏓᎩᎾᏗᏫᏒ ᏍᏗᎩᏗ ᎤᎨᏛᎵᏴ ᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᎭᏂ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏗᏟ ᎦᎢᏒ ᎤᎾ ᏣᎩᏗᏨ ᎦᎶᏪ ᎠᎭᏂ ᏗᏝ -- ᎩᏟ ᎤᏔᏂ ᏕᏥᎾᏝᎥ ᏩᏯ ᎤᎬᎭᏟ ᏍᎩ.. ᎤᎾ ᏥᏓᏅᎤᎾ Ꭱ ᏧᏛᏠᎸ ᏍᎩᎾ ᎩᏟ ᎡᎵ ᏫᏥᏂᏴᎲ --ᎦᏐᎯ ᏃᏭ ᎩᎳ ᎣᏍᏓ ᎠᏩᎵᏍᏛᏡᏅ ᎤᎾ ᎪᎯᏗ ᎠᏬᏢ ᏃᎴ ᎢᏡᎬ --ᎠᏩᎴᏅᎲ Ꮎ ᎢᏡᎬ ᏥᎴᎬ ᏳᏍᏗ ᏃᏭ ᎣᏍᏓ ᏓᏩᎴᏅ ᏩᎩᏴᎲ Ꮎ ᎦᎶᏪ ᎪᎱᏍᏗᏅ ᏳᏰᏟᏗ ᏱᏥᏃᎭᎵᏙ ᏓᎦᏂᎩᏏ ᎠᏪᎵᏒ ᎤᎾ ᎠᎩᎾᎷᏒ. ᎾᎯᏳ ᎬᏪᏙᎸ ᎢᎾᎨ
segments.transliteration: tali heni nadetiyi aginohalvsv awi dagiyvlvsv na nvno diganadiwisv daginadiwisv sdigidi ugedvliyv yusdi ahani galvladi ditli gaisv una tsagiditsv galowe ahani ditla -- gitli utani detsinatlav waya ugvhatli sgi.. una tsidanvuna e tsudvtlolv sgina gitli eli witsiniyvhv --gasohi nowu gila osda awalisdvtlunv una gohidi awotlv nole itlugv --awalenvhv na itlugv tsilegv yusdi nowu osda dawalenv wagiyvhv na galowe gohusdinv yuyetlidi yitsinohalido daganigisi awelisv una aginalusv. nahiyu gvwedolv inage
segments.translation: Yeah. Two years ago I went hunting, looking for deer. There across the road. I went across—it's a little bit of a hollow. I was walking on top, and I fell, and the gun went this way [unintelligible]. I had a big dog that was part wolf. I was laying there when the dog came running over there. I was able to grab his back, then I sat up good. I was sitting there for a long time. I started holding onto a tree, then I stood up good. Then I went and got the gun. I thought “Why should I be hunting? I am going home.” And I went back up. That was the last time I have been in the woods.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.text: ᎠᏯ Ꮫ Ꮎ ᎠᏪᏥ ᎤᏔᏂᏓ ᎣᎩᏂᏃᎲᎸᏒ ᏌᏊ ᏳᏩᎩᏗ Ꮎ ᏅᏱ ᏗᏐᏍᏛ ᏣᎾᏗᎰ Ꮎ rock fence
segments.transliteration: aya dv na awetsi utanida ogininohvlvsv saquu yuwagidi na nvyi disosdv tsanadiho na rock fence
segments.translation: My child, the oldest one, went hunting one time. Where they call Rock Fence.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: Yeah.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.text: ᎤᎾ Ꭿ ᏗᏝ, ᎩᎳ ᏍᏊ -ᎠᎩᏴᏗ ᎦᎶᏪ 270 ᏥᏂᏙᎲ ᏍᎩᎾ -ᎯᎢᏅ ᏗᏝ ᎾᎢᏒ. ᏅᏲ -ᏓᎩᎾᏒᏢ Ꭿ ᏗᏝ ᎠᎩᏅᏨ. ᎠᎩᎨᏳᏒᎾ ᎦᎶᏪ --Ꮭ ᏯᏩᎵᏍᏕᏛ ᎩᎳᏫᏴ Ꮫ ᎤᎷᏨ Ꮎ ᎠᏧᏥ ᏚᏍᎩᎾᏛ --ᏐᎢᏅ ᏴᏣᏩ ᎦᎶᏪ ᏱᏣᏲᏍᏔᎾ ᎯᏐᎯ ᏍᎩᏂ Ᏺ Ꮭ ᏱᎦᏣᏩᎯ ᎠᏬᎮᎸ. ᎦᎶᏪ ᎤᎬᏫᏳ ᏣᎵᏒᎩ ᎠᏬᎮᎸ.
segments.transliteration: una hi ditla, gila squu -agiyvdi galowe 270 tsinidohv sgina -hiinv ditla naisv. nvyo -daginasvtlv hi ditla aginvtsv. agigeyusvna galowe --tla yawalisdedv gilawiyv dv ulutsv na atsutsi dusginadv --soinv yvtsawa galowe yitsayostana hisohi sgini yo tla yigatsawahi awohelv. galowe ugvwiyu tsalisvgi awohelv.
segments.translation: There, on this side, and I had just got a gun, a .270. I had it, and he was walking over there. I slipped on a rock. I fell this way [gestures]. I was protecting the gun and I didn’t help myself. That boy came quickly, cussing. “You can buy another gun if you break it, but you can't buy another back,” he told me. “You protected your gun instead,” he told me.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᎢᎦ Ꮫ ᏥᏈᏍᏓ ᎠᎩᏃᎲᎵᏙᎸ. ᏳᏓᎭᏅ ᎠᏮᏒᏭ ᏨᏥᏃᎠᎴᎬ ᎬᏟ ᏓᎩᏴᎴᎬ ᎩᏟ ᎮᏂ ᏕᏥᎾᏝᎥ Ꮎ red bone ᏥᏓᏃᎮ ᏍᎩ ᏳᏍᏗ
segments.transliteration: iga dv tsiquisda aginohvlidolv. yudahanv awvsvwu tsvtsinoalegv gvtli dagiyvlegv gitli heni detsinatlav na red bone tsidanohe sgi yusdi
segments.translation: I have hunted a lot. Sometimes I would be hunting by myself, looking for coons. I had the kind of dogs they call ‘redbones’.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Did you like that kind?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᎥᎥ, ᏙᏍᏊ ᎣᏏ ᏥᎨᎲ ᏨᎾᎩᏟᏙᏗ. ᏳᏓᎭ ᏔᎵ ᏦᎢ ᎴᏱᎦ ᏕᏥᎥ ᎬᏟ ᏙᏥᏃᎯᎲ
segments.transliteration: vv, dosquu osi tsigehv tsvnagitlidodi. yudaha tali tsoi leyiga detsiv gvtli dotsinohihv
segments.translation: Yeah, they could tree pretty good. Sometimes I would kill two or three coons, and we would bring them back.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.text: ᎾᎯᏳ ᏥᎨᎲ ᏙᎦᏣᎾᏗᏅᏗᏍ ᎨᎮ Ꮎ ᏗᎦᏁᎩ?
segments.transliteration: nahiyu tsigehv dogatsanadinvdis gehe na diganegi?
segments.translation: Back then, were you able to sell those hides?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: Yeah, they were paying pretty good.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: And you didn’t trap sometimes?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: No.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: You didn’t?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᎲᎥ, ᏍᎦᏍᏗ Ꭱ ᏍᏊ ᏥᏂᎬᏮᎩ ᎬᏟ -ᏦᎢ ᏔᎵ ᎴᏱᎦ ᎾᏕᏘᏱᎠ ᏥᏔᎦ -ᏕᎬᎨᎸ ᎤᎾ Ꭱ ᏓᏂᏞᏍᎬ ᎤᎾ ᎩᎳ Ꮎ ᏥᏔᎦ. -- ᎯᎢ -ᏗᏂᏓ ᏕᏥᎾᏝᎥ Ꮎ ᎠᏂᏓᎶᏂᎨ ᏥᏔᎦ ᏧᏪᏥ ᏗᏂᎲᏍᎩ -- ᎠᏭᏛ ᏥᏄᎾᎵᏍᏛᏅ ᏧᎾᎵᏒᏅ
segments.transliteration: hvv, sgasdi e squu tsinigvwvgi gvtli -tsoi tali leyiga nadetiyia tsitaga -degvgelv una e danitlesgv una gila na tsitaga. -- hii -dinida detsinatlav na anidalonige tsitaga tsuwetsi dinihvsgi -- awudv tsinunalisdvnv tsunalisvnv
segments.translation: No, those coons have done me pretty bad. Two or three years ago they killed my chickens. They were getting them chickens off the roost. I had those yellow egg laying chickens that were this big [gestures]. They just went like that, and were gone.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Were they ripping their heads off?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: No.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: They weren't? Did they eat all of them?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: yeah, ᏂᎦᏗ, Ꭽ ᏯᏩᏅᏘ ᏗᎵ ᏱᎩ ᏏᏆ ᎤᏤᏥᏍᏗ ᏱᎩ Ᏺ ᏱᏓᏂᏈᏍᏛᎩ ᏍᏊ ᏱᏓᏂᎩ ᎤᎾ ᏫᏗᎦᏓᏃ ᏭᏩᎦᏛ. ᎾᏅ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎠᏩᏓᏁᎵ barn ᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏟ ᏗᏝ ᎤᏔᎾ ᎢᏡᎬ ᎤᎾᏪ ᏓᏂᏰᏍᎨ Ꮎ ᎬᏟ ᏥᏔᎦ
segments.transliteration: yeah, nigadi, ha yawanvti dili yigi siqua utsetsisdi yigi yo yidaniquisdvgi squu yidanigi una widigadano wuwagadv. nanv usdi awadaneli barn yusdi utli ditla utana itlugv unawe daniyesge na gvtli tsitaga
segments.translation: Yeah, all of them. I don’t know if it’s a skunk or a possum—they will rip the heads off, they will just eat those. The rest of it will be laying there. I have a little building like a barn on this side. There’s a big tree, and those coons were just eating those chickens right there.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Did you trap them, kill them, though?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: Ꭱ ᎩᏝ ᏃᏭ ᏙᏥᎾᏝᎥ ᎤᎾ Ꮭ ᏱᎬᏩᏕᏙᏛᏃ ᎪᎯᏴ ᏥᎩ
segments.transliteration: e gitla nowu dotsinatlav una tla yigvwadedodvno gohiyv tsigi
segments.translation: I have some dogs now. They don’t bother them nowadays.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Oh, so those dogs scare them off.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: Yeah.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Yeah.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.text: ᎾᎾ ᏂᎦ ᏣᏃᎲᎵᏙᎸ ᎢᎾᎨ ᎮᏙᎲ Ꮲ ᎠᎸᎯᏳ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎩᏗ ᏣᏕᎳᎰᏒ ᏱᎩ ᎭᎴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏱᏣᏍᎦᏍᏓᏁᎵ ᎭᎴ ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎩᏗ ᏱᏣᏰᎸᏂ Ꮲ ᎠᎸᎯᏳ ᏍᎩ ᏳᏍᏗ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ?
segments.transliteration: nana niga tsanohvlidolv inage hedohv tlv alvhiyu gohusdi usquanigidi tsadelahosv yigi hale gohusdi yitsasgasdaneli hale usquanigidi yitsayelvni tlv alvhiyu sgi yusdi gohusdi?
segments.translation: What about, as much as you have been in the woods hunting, have you ever seen anything strange that scared you or thought it was interesting? Ever anything like that?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: No, never anything.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.translation: So, you haven’t?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᏍᎩᏛ ᎠᎸᎯᏳ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏱᏣᏕᎳᎰᏌ ᏲᏍᎦᏍᏓᏁᎵ ᏯᏓᎾᏫᏍᏛᏂ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ Ꮫ ᏳᏬᎵᏍᏓᏏ ᏍᎩ ᏯᎩᏪᏎ ᎨᎲ ᎡᏙᏓ ᏓᏤᏝ ᎤᎾ ᏣᎴᏗ ᏓᏤᏝ ᎡᏝᏪᏭ ᎠᏬᏎᎲ
segments.transliteration: sgidv alvhiyu gohusdi yitsadelahosa yosgasdaneli yadanawisdvni gohusdi dv yuwolisdasi sgi yagiwese gehv edoda datsetla una tsaledi datsetla etlawewu awosehv
segments.translation: If you ever notice anything that scares you and if you run, something will happen to you. That’s what my dad used to tell me. It's better if you just stand there and be quiet, he told me.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.text: ᎪᎯᎦ Ꮕ ᏥᎨᎲ ᎢᎦ ᎤᏂᏃᎮᏢᏗ ᏥᎨᎲ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᎾᏕᎳᎰᏒ ᎤᏂᎪᎲ ᎴᏱᎦ
segments.transliteration: gohiga nv tsigehv iga uninohetlvdi tsigehv gohusdi unadelahosv unigohv leyiga
segments.translation: A long time ago they used to really talk about things they noticed or saw…

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: That’s true.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.translation: The people. Something strange, or like a ghost.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: Or they’d see a ghost.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.text: ᏃᎴ ᏴᏫ ᏧᎾᏍᏗ ᏃᎴ ᎯᏛ ᏳᏍᏗ ᎡᎯ ᏯᎾᏗ ᏥᎨᎲ
segments.transliteration: nole yvwi tsunasdi nole hidv yusdi ehi yanadi tsigehv
segments.translation: And also, little people, or also they would say “This exists.”

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: Yeah.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.text: ᏍᎩᎾ ᏴᏫ ᏧᎾᏍᏗ Ꮭ ᏛᏛᎦᏅ ᏱᎦ
segments.transliteration: sgina yvwi tsunasdi tla dvdvganv yiga
segments.translation: What about those little people? Have you heard them?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᏗᎦᏛᎦᏅᏛ ᎠᏎᏃ ᏯᎾᏓᎴᎾᏍᏗ ᎠᏅᏗᎰ ᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎸᎯᏳ Ᏺ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎠᏩᎵᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᏱᎨᎮ
segments.transliteration: digadvganvdv aseno yanadalenasdi anvdiho gesdi alvhiyu yo gohusdi awalisdanelv yigehe
segments.translation: I have heard them. But they say they will get you lost—that has never happened to me.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: But you did hear them?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᏎᎦᏨ ᏗᎦᏛᎦᏅ ᎡᏲ ᏃᎴ ᎠᏂᏬᏂᏍᎬ ᎢᏅᎨ Ꮲ ᏱᎨᏙ ᏙᏛᎳ ᏱᎦ ᎩᎶ ᎦᏬᏂᏍᎬ ᎢᎦᏛᎩᏍᎪ
segments.transliteration: segatsv digadvganv eyo nole aniwonisgv invge tlv yigedo dodvla yiga gilo gawonisgv igadvgisgo
segments.translation: But I have heard them. I heard them talking when I was in the woods somewhere on the mountain. I would hear someone talking.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Could you not understand it?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: I couldn’t understand it.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.text: ᎠᏂᏐ ᎮᏂ ᏍᏊ ᏕᎦᎵᏃᎮᏗ ᎠᏂᏃᎮᏍᎪ ᏕᎦᏛᎦᏅ ᎠᎾᏗ ᏍᎩᏂ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎩᎶ ᏕᎦᏛᎦᏅ ᎠᏗᎲ ᏓᏥᏯᏛᏛᏂ ᎦᎪᏟᏍᏙᏗ ᏱᎦ ᎨᎵᎲ ᎮᏂ. ᏝᎲᏲ ᎦᎪᏟᏍᏗ ᏱᎨᎮ ᎠᏂᏬᏂᏍᎬ
segments.transliteration: aniso heni squu degalinohedi aninohesgo degadvganv anadi sgini taline gilo degadvganv adihv datsiyadvdvni gagotlisdodi yiga gelihv heni. tlahvyo gagotlisdi yigehe aniwonisgv
segments.translation: I have talked to some others, too. They said they heard them. I thought, the next time I hear someone say they heard them, I am going to ask them if they understood them. But you could not understand them talking?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᏌᏭ ᏳᏩᎩᏗ ᎮᏂᏲ Ꮎ ᏅᏱ ᎣᏓᎳ ᎤᎦᏃᏩ ᏗᏝ ᎦᏚᏏ ᎮᏂ ᏥᎦᏁᎸ ᎡᏚᏓ ᏥᎨᎲ Ꮎ ᎠᏂᏧᏣ -ᎣᏣᎢᏒ ᎤᎾ ᏠᎨᏏ ᎠᏪᎨ ᎤᏔᏂ ᎠᏛᎴᏏ ᎤᎾᏛᎾ Ꮎ ᎦᏙ ᎤᎾ -ᏬᎩᎷᏨ ᎯᎾ ᏱᎩᏓ locust ᎦᏅᎯᏓ ᎦᎭᏛ ᎣᏍᏓ ᏓᏫᏍᎬᎨᏪ ᏥᎨᎲ ᎭᏗ ᏯᏩᏅᏘ ᎬᏟ ᏱᎩ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎴᏱᎩ ᏯᏂᎵᏙ ᎤᎾ ᏍᎩ ᏱᎦ ᏴᏓᏅᎦᎸᏗ ᎨᎲ ᏓᏪᏍᎬᎨᏭ Ꮫ ᏥᎨᎲ Ꭱ ᎢᏓᏛᏅᎾ ᎤᏛᎾ Ꮎ ᎠᏧᏥ ᏥᏓᏂᎩᏗ ᎤᏛᎾ ᏙᎩᎾᏗᏒ Ꮎ Wilma mankiller ᏥᎦᏁᎵ -- ᎪᎯᎦ ᎤᎾ ᏦᏥᏁᎸ ᎤᎾ ᏥᏳᎩᏗ ᏦᎩᏅᏗᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᎲ Ꮎ ᎡᏚᏓ ᏥᎨᎲ ᏧᏕᏅ ᎤᎾ ᎨᏫᏴ ᎣᎦᏂᎩᏓ ᏓᏳᏪᏡᎾ ᎠᎬᏴᎵᎨ hey ᎭᏢ ᏫᏥᎶ ᎢᏥᏧᏣ ᏗᏣᏧᎾ ᏓᏳᏛᏅ
segments.transliteration: sawu yuwagidi heniyo na nvyi odala uganowa ditla gadusi heni tsiganelv eduda tsigehv na anitsutsa -otsaisv una tlogesi awege utani advlesi unadvna na gado una -wogilutsv hina yigida locust ganvhida gahadv osda dawisgvgewe tsigehv hadi yawanvti gvtli yigi gohusdi leyigi yanilido una sgi yiga yvdanvgalvdi gehv dawesgvgewu dv tsigehv e idadvnvna udvna na atsutsi tsidanigidi udvna doginadisv na Wilma mankiller tsiganeli -- gohiga una tsotsinelv una tsiyugidi tsoginvdihisdi gehv na eduda tsigehv tsudenv una gewiyv oganigida dayuwetluna agvyvlige hey hatlv witsilo itsitsutsa ditsatsuna dayudvnv
segments.translation: One time at Rocky Mountain, to the south, my grandfather lived on a hill. Me and the boys were walking in the field. And they said “There is a big hole over there in the ground.” We went there, and there was a locust [tree] this big [gestures]. It was long and sticking in there—it was just smooth. I don’t know if it was coons or something was crawling around on there, it was clean. It was just smooth. “Y’all get away,,” the boy said. “Let’s leave!”, he said. We went across to where Wilma Mankiller lives. We used to live there a long time ago. We used to cross straight through there to where my grandfather lived. We went just a little ways, and an old lady screamed. She said, “Hey where did you boys go? You all come back,” she said.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: There, where the hole was?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: Ꭵ, ᎤᎾ ᏗᏔᎴᏒ ᎾᎡ ᎠᏂᏐ ᎠᏂᏧᏣ ᏚᎾᏛᎾᏫᏍᏛᏅᏛ ᏝᎦ ᎠᏩᎴᏅ ᎤᎾ ᎠᎩᏛᏓᏍᏛ ᏏᏭ ᎧᎮ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏗᎠᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎨᎵᎲ --ᏍᏊ ᎡᏲ ᎢᎦ ᏄᏪᏒ ᏩᏩᏓᎾᏫᏍᏛᏅ ᏍᏊ ᎠᏯ ᏧᎾᏍᏛᏰᏒᏛ ᏭᏂᎷᏨ ᎦᎵᏦᏕᏳ Ꮎ ᎠᏂᏧᏣ ᏚᎾᏓᎾᏫᏍᏛᏅ ᏍᎩ ᏱᎦ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏍᏓᏁᎸ
segments.transliteration: v, una ditalesv nae aniso anitsutsa dunadvnawisdvnvdv tlaga awalenv una agidvdasdv siwu kahe gohusdi diadisgesdi gelihv --squu eyo iga nuwesv wawadanawisdvnv squu aya tsunasdvyesvdv wunilutsv galitsodeyu na anitsutsa dunadanawisdvnv sgi yiga unisgasdanelv
segments.translation: Yeah, where the hole was. The other boys started running. I stood there for a little bit and listened. I was wondering if she was going to say something again, but that was all she said. Then I started running too. Those boys were tired out when they got to the house. It really scared them.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: You didn't go see for yourself?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᎲᎥ, ᏝᏲ ᏳᏩᎩᏛᏁ. ᎾᎯᏳ ᏍᏊ ᎬᏪᏙᎸ ᎤᎾ ᏗᏝ
segments.transliteration: hvv, tlayo yuwagidvne. nahiyu squu gvwedolv una ditla
segments.translation: No, I didn’t go look. I haven’t been back over there since.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.text: Ꮭ ᎠᎸᎯᏳ ᎢᏥᏴᏢ ᏱᎨᎮ Ꮎ ᎠᏔᎴᏒ?
segments.transliteration: tla alvhiyu itsiyvtlv yigehe na atalesv?
segments.translation: You all never went in that hole?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᎲᎥ, ᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᎸᎯᏳ ᎠᎩᏴᏢ ᏱᎨᎮ. ᎾᏲ ᏗᏐ Ꮎ Coon Mt. ᏣᏃᎮᎰ --ᏗᎩᏴᏢ ᏌᏊ ᏳᏩᎩᏗ ᎮᏂ ᏭᏂᎷᏨ ᎠᏂᏧᏥ ᎪᎦ ᏕᏝ ᏃᏭ ᎨᎲ ᎭᏢᏴ ᎠᏔᎴᏏ ᏧᏫᏴᎯᎰ ᎬᏬᎮᎸ ᎤᎾᏚᎵᎲ ᎤᏁᏅᏍᏗ ᎣᎨᏅᏒ ᎠᎬᏱᏩᎩᏴᏢ ᎾᏅ ᎠᏂᏐ ᏃᏭ -- ᎠᏛᏅᏏᏅᏍᏙᏗ ᎮᏂ ᏳᏍᏗ ᏥᎨᏒ ᎾᎾ ᎤᏔᏂ ᏩᏔᎴᏒ ᎠᎭᏂᏅ ᏅᏱ -- ᎠᏰᏍᏓᎥ boy ᎾᏛ ᎤᏦᏅᏔᏅ ᎢᎾᏗ ᎦᏳᎳ ᏫᏥᏯᎥ ᏫᏥᏨᎢᏍᏛᏅ ᎯᎡ ᏱᎩᏓ ᎠᏝᎥ ᎤᎾ coon tail
segments.transliteration: hvv, hesdi alvhiyu agiyvtlv yigehe. nayo diso na Coon Mt. tsanoheho --digiyvtlv saquu yuwagidi heni wunilutsv anitsutsi goga detla nowu gehv hatlvyv atalesi tsuwiyvhiho gvwohelv unadulihv unenvsdi ogenvsv agvyiwagiyvtlv nanv aniso nowu -- advnvsinvsdodi heni yusdi tsigesv nana utani watalesv ahaninv nvyi -- ayesdav boy nadv utsonvtanv inadi gayula witsiyav witsitsvisdvnv hie yigida atlav una coon tail
segments.translation: No, I’ve never been there. Those other ones, on Coon Mountain, they call it. We’ve been in them. One time some boys came, and it was towards summertime. They said “Where is that hole you go into?” They were wanting to go, so we went. I went in first, and then the others. You had to kind of crawl, then the hole was big, and here, there was a rock there. Boy, a snake made a smell, and I was already in there. I turned the light on and there was a coontail this big [gestures] laying there.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: And you went by there?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᎠᎩᎶᏒ ᎤᎾ ᎭᏫᎾ ᏗᏝ ᏅᏱ ᎮᏂ ᎠᏰᏍᏓᎥ
segments.transliteration: agilosv una hawina ditla nvyi heni ayesdav
segments.translation: I went by there, underneath. There was a rock laying there.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Oh, gah.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᏫᏥᏅᎪᎠ ᎦᏥᏲᎮᎳ Ꮎ ᎠᏂᏧᏥ ᏭᏂᏅᎪᏨ ᏃᏍᏊ ᎠᎬᏢᏛ ᎠᏨᏍᏗ ᏛᎩᏅᎪᏨ Ꭱ Ꮩ ᏓᏛᏛᏁᎵ ᎤᏛᎾ Ꮭ ᎮᏲ ᏓᏥᏴᎵ Ᏺ ᎠᏯ ᎨᎲ ᎦᏥᏲᎮᎸ Ꮎ ᏌᏊ ᏳᏩᎦᏗ Ꭱ ᎠᏓ ᎤᏲᎲ Ᏼ ᏱᎩᏓ ᎤᏴᏩᏛᎲ ᎣᏍᏓ ᏱᎦᏅᎯᏓ Ꮩ ᏛᏛᏁᎵ ᏥᏲᎮᎲ --ᏫᏓᏗᏴᏟᏛ ᎤᏛᏅ ᏫᏘᏴᏟ ᎴᏱᎦ ᏥᏲᎮᎸ ᏝᏲ ᎠᏯ ᏥᏲᎮᎸ ᏣᏥᎸᎡ Ꮎ ᎢᎾᏓ ᏭᏴᏢ ᎮᏂ Ꮎ ᎠᏧᏥ ᎤᎾ
segments.transliteration: witsinvgoa gatsiyohela na anitsutsi wuninvgotsv nosquu agvtlvdv atsvsdi dvginvgotsv e do dadvdvneli udvna tla heyo datsiyvli yo aya gehv gatsiyohelv na saquu yuwagadi e ada uyohv yv yigida uyvwadvhv osda yiganvhida do dvdvneli tsiyohehv --widadiyvtlidv udvnv witiyvtli leyiga tsiyohelv tlayo aya tsiyohelv tsatsilve na inada wuyvtlv heni na atsutsi una
segments.translation: I told them boys to go out, and they went out. I turned out the light and came out. “What are we going to do?” he said. I said, “I'm not going in there.” That one was looking for wood, and found one this big [gestures]. It was long. “What are you going to do?” I said. “We are going in there”, he said. "Or, you are going in there, not me," I told him. That boy, he killed that snake when he went in there.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Did those snakes live there?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: I guess they lived there.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: And you used to go in there all the time?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: In the wintertime it was all the time.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Oh yeah.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᎪᎵ ᎮᏂ ᏱᎦ ᎤᏴᏟ Ꮭ ᏱᎬᏓᏅᎾ ᎢᎾᏓ -ᏳᎦᏅᏬᏒ ᏍᎩᏂ Ᏺ ᎤᏍᎦᏍᏗ
segments.transliteration: goli heni yiga uyvtli tla yigvdanvna inada -yuganvwosv sgini yo usgasdi
segments.translation: In the wintertime when it’s cold, a snake will not move. But if it warms, it will move hard.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.text: ᏌᏊ ᏳᏩᎦᏗ ᏥᏥᏃᎭᎵᏙᎲ -ᏥᏥᏩᏛᏛᏅ ᏌᏭ Ꮎ Maxwell mountain ᏣᏃᎮᎰ ᎤᎾ ᎡᎳ ᏗᏝ --ᎠᎹᏱ ᏙᏛᎩᎾᏗᏒ bank ᏄᏍᏓ ᎤᎾ ᎠᎩᎶᏒ ᎠᏭᏴ ᎠᎲ ᏥᏄᏛᏅ ᏍᏓᏯ ᏦᏓᏃᏩᎸᏒ Ꭰ ᏥᏄᏛᏅ ᏍᏓᏯ Ꭰ ᏱᎬᏁᎳ ᏧᏥᏯᏅᏕᏒ ᏧᏭᎵᏐᏩᎴᏢ ᏣᎩᏍᎦᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᏍᎩᏂ Ᏺ
segments.transliteration: saquu yuwagadi tsitsinohalidohv -tsitsiwadvdvnv sawu na Maxwell mountain tsanoheho una ela ditla --amayi dodvginadisv bank nusda una agilosv awuyv ahv tsinudvnv sdaya tsodanowalvsv a tsinudvnv sdaya a yigvnela tsutsiyanvdesv tsuwulisowaletlv tsagisgasdanelv sgini yo
segments.translation: One time I was hunting I accidentally found one, where they call it Maxwell Mountain. Below there, I crossed the water and got on the bank. Just right there it was like this hard. It was coiled up like this hard. I kicked it, like this, it started rolling. It scared me, though.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: Ꮎ Ꭱ copper head ᏥᏓᏃᎮ ᏙᎯᏳ ᎭᏗ Ᏺ warning ᏱᎬᎾᏓᎲᏍᏏ
segments.transliteration: na e copper head tsidanohe dohiyu hadi yo warning yigvnadahvssi
segments.translation: Those ones they call copperheads, they won’t give you a warning.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: They will come after you, ain’t it?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: yeah, ᎩᎳᏫᏛ ᏱᎬᏩᏍᎦᎵ, ᎾᏅ ᎤᏦᎾᏘ ᏱᎦ ᏯᏦᏅᏛᎩ Ꮫ
segments.transliteration: yeah, gilawidv yigvwasgali, nanv utsonati yiga yatsonvdvgi dv
segments.translation: Yeah, they will bite you quickly. And, if it’s a rattler, it will rattle.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: It will tell you.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: Yeah.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.text: ᎾᎮᏂ Ꮎ Greenleaf ᏥᏓᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸ Malloy Hollow ᏙᏛᏥᎾᏗᏫᏍᎪ ᏥᎨᎲ ᏌᏊ ᏳᏩᏗ Ꮫ ᎤᎾ ᏗᎦᎢᏒ -Ꮭ ᏯᏅᏓᏗ Ꮎ man ᎢᎦ ᎮᏂ ᏍᏊ ᎠᏮᎨᏫᏒᏗ ᎠᏂ-Hooper Ꮭ ᏯᏅᏓᏗ Ꮎ ᎠᏂ ᏧᏂᏫᏒ ᏌᏊ ᏳᏩᎩᏗ?
segments.transliteration: naheni na Greenleaf tsidagilvwisdanelv Malloy Hollow dodvtsinadiwisgo tsigehv saquu yuwadi dv una digaisv -tla yanvdadi na man iga heni squu awvgewisvdi ani-Hooper tla yanvdadi na ani tsuniwisv saquu yuwagidi?
segments.translation: When I was working at Greenleaf, I would cross through Malloy Hollow. One time I was coming through there. Do you remember? Man, I forget things. Them Hoopers—do you remember where they had that strawberry planted one time?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: Yeah, O.D. [Hooper].

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.text: ᎥᎥ, ᎤᎾ ᎮᏂ ᏓᎩᎶᏐᏅ ᏂᏚᎾᏗᏫᏒ Ꮭ ᎤᏔᏂ ᏱᎨᏎ ᎤᎦᏑᏗ ᎯᎢᏭ Ꮫ Ꮲ ᏂᎦᏅᎲ ᏂᏚᎾᏗᏫᏏᏗᏒ ᏗᎦᏚᎴᏂ ᏍᏊ ᎣᏂ ᏛᏟᏒ ᎤᎾ ᏩᏩᎴᏫᏍᏛᏅ ᎠᏯ ᎠᏩᏝᏔᏗᏅᏒ ᏥᎦᏙᏍᏙ ᏘᎵᏍᎢ ᎠᏬᎮᎸ? Ꮧ Ꮫ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏥᏴᏙᏗ ᏱᎦ ᎠᏯᏍ ᏱᏥᎷᎦ ᎠᏬᎮᎸ ᎦᏳᎵᏅ ᏍᏊ ᏭᏴᏢ ᎨᎲ Ꮎ -- ᏙᏛ ᏴᏗ? ᎦᏄᎸ ᎤᎾ ᏭᏴᏢ ᎨᎲ ᎦᏳᎳ yeah ᎯᎢᏍᏚᏭ ᏥᏲᎮᎸ ᎦᎶᏪ ᏭᎸᎲ boy Ꮧ ᏍᏊ ᎠᎭᏂᏅ ᏱᏗᎦᏂᎩ ᏳᏪᎵᏏ ᏭᏴᏢ ᎤᎾ ᎠᏯ ᎮᏂ ᎡᎵ ᏩᎩᏖᏃᎸ ᏳᏩ ᎾᏂ ᏭᏴᏢᏭ Ꮫ ᏲᎮᏂ ᏩᏥᏩᏛᎲ -ᏩᏥᏲᎸ -- -ᎡᎵᏭ ᎮᏂ ᏱᏥᏁᎦᎵ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏱᎪᏢᏗ ᎦᏁᎩ ᎤᏛᏅ ᎠᏥᎸ ᏩᏥᎸᏅ ᏱᎨᎲ ᎤᎾ
segments.transliteration: vv, una heni dagilosonv nidunadiwisv tla utani yigese ugasudi hiiwu dv tlv niganvhv nidunadiwisidisv digaduleni squu oni dvtlisv una wawalewisdvnv aya awatlatadinvsv tsigadosdo tilisi awohelv? di dv gohusdi tsiyvdodi yiga ayas yitsiluga awohelv gayulinv squu wuyvtlv gehv na -- dodv yvdi? ganulv una wuyvtlv gehv gayula yeah hiisduwu tsiyohelv galowe wulvhv boy di squu ahaninv yidiganigi yuwelisi wuyvtlv una aya heni eli wagitenolv yuwa nani wuyvtlvwu dv yoheni watsiwadvhv -watsiyolv -- -eliwu heni yitsinegali gohusdi yigotlvdi ganegi udvnv atsilv watsilvnv yigehv una
segments.translation: Yeah, I was coming through there. It was crossing—it wasn’t a big rattler. It was just this long [gestures]. It was going across, and there was a car coming. And I stopped, I got out and was watching it. “Are going to kill it?” he said. And I said “No, ‘cause I have no use for it.” “Can I kill it?” he said. It had already went into the grass, it had went in there. I told him “Just kill it.” He went, got a gun. He didn’t even think it might be laying there, he went in there. If it was me, I would have looked around. But he just went in there. He found it and shot it. He said he might skin it and make something out of the hide. He killed it and put it in there.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᏭᏔᏅ ᏥᎩᎥ ᎢᎾᏓ Ꮎ Loredo, Texas ᏬᏤᎲ ᏬᏤᏙᎲ -ᏚᏯ ᏓᏅᏕᏍᎬ bean harvest springdale ᎮᏂ ᏥᏓᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎤᎾ four hundred acres ᏚᏂᏫᏒᏗ ᎤᎾ ᏗᎦᏕᏍᏗ ᎤᏛᎾ ᏧᎧᎵᏏ ᏭᏔᎾ ᏥᎪᎥ ᎤᎾ ᎢᎾᏓ Ꭿi ᏱᎩᏓ
segments.transliteration: wutanv tsigiv inada na Loredo, Texas wotsehv wotsedohv -duya danvdesgv bean harvest springdale heni tsidagilvwisdanehv una four hundred acres duniwisvdi una digadesdi udvna tsukalisi wutana tsigov una inada hii yigida
segments.translation: The biggest snake I seen—we went to Laredo, Texas. They were picking beans, bean harvest. I was working in Springdale. They had 400 acres of beans planted. “We have to pick there,” the boss said. The biggest snake I seen was there, it was this big [gestures].

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: A rattler.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᎤᎦᏑᏘ coontail ᏓᏃᎮ Ꮎ ᏥᏗᏦᎷᏫᏴ ᏕᏥᎪᎵᏰᎲ ᏚᏂᏅᏛ ᏚᏯ ᎦᏳᎵᏅ ᏛᎲ Ꮎ ᏚᏯ ᏗᎦᏕᏍᏗ ᎤᎾ ᏥᏙᏩᏕᎬ ᏕᎯᏴᎭ ᎠᎭᏂ ᏔᎴᎾ ᎠᎭᏂ ᏔᎵ ᏚᏓᏅᏅ ᏍᏗᎩᏓ ᏗᏯᏖᎾ ᏳᏍᏗ ᎨᎲ ᎥᏍᏊ --ᏯᏩᏂᎩᏎ ᎯᎢ ᏗᏝ ᏳᏥᎳᏍᏛᏁ ᏛᎮ ᎢᎾ ᎴᎯᎩ Ꮲ ᏯᏩᏙᏎ
segments.transliteration: ugasuti coontail danohe na tsiditsoluwiyv detsigoliyehv duninvdv duya gayulinv dvhv na duya digadesdi una tsidowadegv dehiyvha ahani talena ahani tali dudanvnv sdigida diyatena yusdi gehv vsquu --yawanigise hii ditla yutsilasdvne dvhe ina lehigi tlv yawadose
segments.translation: A rattler, a coontail [diamondback]. About where you are sitting. I was looking at the rows of beans. The bean picker was already sitting there. I was standing around there. I said, “Come in here and start–” where the two rows were kind of wider. If I would have just went that far, this way, I probably would have stepped on it. Or it would have latched on to me.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.translation: It might have swallowed you.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᎣᏍᏓ -- Ꮎ ᏧᏂᎩᏌ ᏚᏯ ᏗᎦᏕᏍᎩ ᎣᏍᏚ ᎠᎢᏒ ᎯᎢᏂᏴ ᏗᏕᎩ Ꮎ ᏗᎦᏕᏍᎩ belt ᎢᏂ ᎠᎭᏂ ᎠᏝ ᎤᎾ ᏍᏓᏯ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᎩᎳᏫ ᎢᎪᎯᏓ ᎤᏃᏴᎸᏍᎠ Ꮎ ᎤᏪᏡᏅᏛ Ꮎ ᎠᏧᏣ ᎠᎯᎵᏙ ᎢᎾᏓᎡ ᎤᏛᏅ ᎩᎶ ᎡᎵ gas Ꮫ ᏍᏗ ᏱᏅᏁᎵ ᏥᏲᎮᎸ -- ᏭᏪᏒᏙᏴ Ꮎ feed ᎣᏍᏗᏭ Ꮺ ᏚᏂᎩᏒ ᏭᎸᏥᏢ ᎢᎾᏓ Ꮎ belt ᏄᏍᏓ ᎠᎭᏂᏃ dumpster -- ᎣᏍᏗᏭ Ꮫ ᏭᏬᎯᎶᏒ dumpster Ꭲ ᏫᎦᏂᏏᏁᎲ ᏚᏯ ᏭᏂᎸᏍᏗ ᎤᎾ ᏧᏭᎸᏥᏢ ᏍᎦᏍᏗ Ꮫ ᎤᏦᏅᏙ ᎾᏅ ᎠᏍᏆᏂ ᎤᎷᏨ -ᏙᏘᏴᏁᎵ ᎠᏬᎮᎸ. Ꮧ ᏯᏩᏅᏕ ᏥᏲᎮᎸ ᏂᎾ ᏙᏘᏴᏁᎵ ᏥᏲᎮᎸ ᎦᎶᏪ ᏭᎸᎲ Ꮎ pickup Ꭲ ᏛᏟᎲ -- ᎤᎾ Ꭱ ᏣᏥᎸ Ꮎ ᎢᎾᏓ ᎤᎾ ᏃᎾ Ꮟ ᎠᎢᏍᎬᏅ ᎠᎢᏒ Ꮎ ᏚᏯ ᏗᎦᏕᏍᎩ idle ᏄᏍᏓ dump ᏂᏥᏴᏁᎸ Ꮎ dumpster ᏭᏅᏨ ᎡᎳᏗ ᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏍᏆᏂ -ᏭᏖᏒ pickup Ꭲ ᏧᏭᎸᏅ ᏩᏥᎾᏫᏛᎲ Ꮎ ᏭᎵᏍᏛ ᏐᏱ ᎤᎾ ᏛᏍᎪᏍᎬ --ᏧᏭᏂᏌᏅᏏ ᎢᎾᏓ. ᎡᎵ ᎮᏂ ᎣᏍᏓ ᏱᎦᏅᎯᏓ ᎤᏍᎪᏒ ᎤᎾ ᏧᏩᏥᎸᏅ ᎢᎦ Ꮫ ᎦᏂᏰᎩ ᎨᎲ ᏚᏯ ᏗᎦᏕᏍᏗ ᎤᎾᎴᏅ Ꭿ ᏗᏂᏅᎯᏓ ᏓᏄᏖᏍᏗᎲ ᎾᏅ truck ᎤᏔᏂ ᎠᎯᎵᏙ pitch fork ᎦᏁᎲ ᏩᎩᏠ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎣᏍᏓ level ᏛᎦ ᎠᏬᎮᎸ ᏚᏯ ᏙᏛᏎ Ꮭ ᎠᏯ ᎨᎲ ᏥᏲᎮᎸ -ᏂᎯᏂ ᏣᏤᎵ truck ᏂᎯᏂ ᏱᏣᏛᏂᏗ ᏥᏲᎮᎸ
segments.transliteration: osda -- na tsunigisa duya digadesgi osdu aisv hiiniyv didegi na digadesgi belt ini ahani atla una sdaya nulistanv gilawi igohida unoyvlvsa na uwetlunvdv na atsutsa ahilido inadae udvnv gilo eli gas dv sdi yinvneli tsiyohelv -- wuwesvdoyv na feed osdiwu we dunigisv wulvtsitlv inada na belt nusda ahanino dumpster -- osdiwu dv wuwohilosv dumpster i wiganisinehv duya wunilvsdi una tsuwulvtsitlv sgasdi dv utsonvdo nanv asquani ulutsv -dotiyvneli awohelv. di yawanvde tsiyohelv nina dotiyvneli tsiyohelv galowe wulvhv na pickup i dvtlihv -- una e tsatsilv na inada una nona si aisgvnv aisv na duya digadesgi idle nusda dump nitsiyvnelv na dumpster wunvtsv eladi sgi na asquani -wutesv pickup i tsuwulvnv watsinawidvhv na wulisdv soyi una dvsgosgv --tsuwunisanvsi inada. eli heni osda yiganvhida usgosv una tsuwatsilvnv iga dv ganiyegi gehv duya digadesdi unalenv hi dininvhida danutesdihv nanv truck utani ahilido pitch fork ganehv wagitlo galvladi osda level dvga awohelv duya dodvse tla aya gehv tsiyohelv -nihini tsatseli truck nihini yitsadvnidi tsiyohelv
segments.translation: Yeah. When that bean picker [truck] started coming, it was coming just right. The pickers are this big [gestures] and the belt is laying here. It went like this, and made a sound. That boy, that was driving, quickly screamed, “There is a snake,” he said. “Wait,” I said, “Give it a little more gas.” He pushed the feet, it went good. The snake just fell perfectly in there, where the belt was. Then it went perfectly over the dumpster. And he was pulling the dumpster where the beans fell in. And it fell in there—it was rattling hard. That Mexican came and said, “What are you going to do with it?” I said, “I don’t know. What are you going to do with it?” I told him. He went, got a gun from the pickup. He was running. He killed that snake right there. That bean picker was running, it was idling. I dumped the dumpster. It [the snake] fell on the ground. That Mexican picked it up and put it in the pickup. He took it to the end of the fence he was over there digging. And he buried it. He dug a pretty long hole, he put it in there. It was dangerous to pick beans. Since they started, they would pick some up this long [gestures]. The one that was driving that big truck, was holding a pitchfork. He said, “Get up there and level those beans.” As for me, I don’t think so. ”It’s your truck, you do it,” I told him.

segments.translation: My son they got sent to Texas. He used to fight fires—he was a Fire Dancer. He was in that group. When that space shuttle fell, they had to find the remaining parts. They got hired in Texas. He was saying they were seeing snakes, “One right after another we were killing them.” He said “Someone found out we were killing them. Someone came and said ‘The next time I find out one of you all killed a snake, you are going home’.” He said “Sometimes we would be walking over the sage, or something was this tall [gestures]. Sometimes their heads would be above that, doing this [gestures]. They warned us not to kill them.” he said.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: Ꮎ ᏗᎾᏓᎸ texas ᎦᏁᎵ Ꭽ ᏯᏩᏅᏘ Ᏼ ᎨᎲ ᎤᏔᏂ ranch ᎤᎾ Ꮫ ᏧᎾᏔᏂ ᎢᎾᏓ -ᎠᏂᎷᎪ ᎦᎵᏦᏕ ᏣᏗᎲ Ꮎ ᏯᏖᏃ ᎭᏫᎾ ᏗᏝ. ᎦᎾᏰᎩ Ꮫ ᎤᎾ ᏗᏝ

segments.translation: Her sister lives in Texas. I don’t know where… ‘big ranch. She said “Those big snakes come to the house, underneath the floor.” It’s dangerous out that way.

segments.transliteration: sgidv usdayvhvsgi tla yunihe washer and dryer udvyotlitlv dvgvyugilosdi yiga awu ditlaniyv dvdanelv usdi unani doginihv -widitsagilosdudv tla heni yidigvgilo agohelv una waisv sgina tsowa usgvlitsv hi nusdv usgalitsv unatinvsv ganagati daunadvnv phone nae tsiganagati uduli hiwadvdi na inada -dayunadvnv doge iganvtanv yusdi gehv -gatsiyoselv. wiwadi gvwohelv usvnv gehv na explorer tsidanohe na digaduleni oginihv sgidvnv 270 awvyv tsigadi wagiyvhv sgina explorer i wawatsanv una dv awatsao tsiyoho tsiwadvhv eyo -- yv yigida fifty five gallon drum yusdinv ahv una gatlanv igadi una -tsugilv gayulinv squu a tsinudvnv tsagatiyvwu soi tsitsilv eyo donv copper head dv tsigatsiyohelv tleyo yudatsinawidv tsigatsiyohelv
segments.translation: Him and his wife didn’t have one. So he asked if he could come do his laundry. There was a little building over there, and that’s where we had them. She told him “You can go wash. I’m not washing.” He was going that way and got bit by a copperhead, it bit here [gestures]. They took him to the doctor. They used the phone to call back, and said “That doctor wants you to find that snake.” I told them, “Why? We know what kind it is.” And it was nighttime. Them cars they call Explorer [SUV], we had one. I went, got that .270 [gun]. I said I had got in that Explorer. I was sitting in there, looking for it. I did find it. It was yea big [gestures]. There was kind of like a 55-gallon drum sitting there. Some of it [the copperhead] was in there. He was on there, already, like this, waiting for another one. I killed it though. I told them it was a copper’. But I wasn’t going to take it, I told them.

segments.translation: No. My dad’s dad—you could say my grandfather. He was gigging [hunting with a pronged-spear], going underneath at Caney. One like that [moccasin] was perched up here, and it bit him here [gestures]. They said they could not get him to the doctor. Before they got him there, they said, he passed. His name was Scott Wolfe. I think that was a long time ago. They say that’s all he used to do, go around gigging.

segments.translation: Gah

segments.translation: His name was Scott Wolfe... I think they said that’s all he would do back then—gigging.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.text: ᎤᎾ Ꮫ Ꮎ lion switch Ꮎ ᏥᎦᏗ Ꮎ rufus smith ᏥᎦᏁᎸ ᎤᎾ ᎮᏂ ᏳᏓᎭ -ᏫᎨᏙ ᏥᎨᎲ Ꮎ Tommy, Tommy Smith ᏗᏧᎳ ᏙᏍᏗᏂᏙᎲ ᎤᎾᏅ -ᏲᏣᏂᎦ ᏥᎨᎲ Ꮎ ᎦᎶᏪ ᏙᏥᏴᏫᏓ ᏥᎨᎲ Lloyd sanders Ꮭ ᏯᏩᏅᏗ ᎯᏲᎵᎦ ᏱᎩ Lloyd

segments.translation: There where I said, near Lyon Switch, where Rufus Smith lived. I used to go over there sometimes. Me and Tommy Smith were in the same grade. We would go from there, and take guns. Lloyd Sanders—I don’t know if you know Lloyd?

segments.translation: Yes.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: They had a place to swim.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Yes.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᎯᏃ Ꮭ ᏯᏩᏅᏘ ᏄᏍᏗᏓᏅ ᎬᏪᏙᎸ ᎥᎾ ᏗᏝ
segments.transliteration: hino tla yawanvti nusdidanv gvwedolv vna ditla
segments.translation: I don’t know how it is now. It’s been a long time since I have been there.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.text: ᏛᎮ ᎠᏎ ᏃᏭ Ꮭ ᎤᎾ ᎨᎲ ᏱᏄᏍᏗ
segments.transliteration: dvhe ase nowu tla una gehv yinusdi
segments.translation: I don’t think there is one there now.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: Ꮎ ᎮᏂ Flute Springs -ᏧᎾᏓᏂᏐᏗ ᏥᎪᏢ ᎦᏚᏌ ᏗᏝ Isaac Bush ᏥᎦᏁᎸ
segments.transliteration: na heni Flute Springs -tsunadanisodi tsigotlv gadusa ditla Isaac Bush tsiganelv
segments.translation: There, where the Flute Springs are, above the cemetery. Isaac Bush used to live there.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Yes.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: We had a road there. We would go down to Sallisaw Creek.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: You all had a way to get there.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: yeah, ᏳᏓᎭ ᏧᏬᎩᏒᎯᎲ ᎤᎾ fourth of july ᏍᎦᏍᏗ ᏙᏥᎯᎲ ᎢᎾᏓ ᎤᎾ ᎠᏣᏗᏅ ᏍᏊ
segments.transliteration: yeah, yudaha tsuwogisvhihv una fourth of july sgasdi dotsihihv inada una atsadinv squu
segments.translation: Yeah, sometimes we would spend the night. If it was the Fourth of July. We would really kill snakes there, and fish.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.text: yeah, ᏲᏛ ᏥᏈᏍᏓ ᎮᏂ ᎠᏁᎲ ᎢᎾᏓ
segments.transliteration: yeah, yodv tsiquisda heni anehv inada
segments.translation: Yeah, there really was a lot.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: Yeah, there is a lot, out that way.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.text: ᏃᏭ ᏓᏣᏰᏘᏏ ᎬᏯᏛᏛᏅ Ꭿ ᎾᎾ bigfoot ᏣᏂᏃᎮᏍᎪ Ꮩ ᎮᎵᏍᎪ?
segments.transliteration: nowu datsayetisi gvyadvdvnv hi nana bigfoot tsaninohesgo do helisgo?
segments.translation: You are going to laugh when I ask you this. What about that Bigfoot, they talk about [that]? what do you think?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᎠᏩᏝᏏᏛᎡᎰ ᎠᏯ ᎨᎲ ᎬᏂ ᏛᎮ ᎩᎳ ᏱᏥᎪᎥ
segments.transliteration: awatlasidveho aya gehv gvni dvhe gila yitsigov
segments.translation: I doubt it myself, unless I see him.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: You would believe it.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᎰᏩ ᏱᎨᎵ ᎾᏅ ᎠᏂᏃᎮᏍᎬ Ꮭ Ꮎ ᎮᏂ ᎠᏧᏣ Ꭱ tommy ᎤᏪᏥ Ꮎ ᎤᏔᏂᏓ ᎧᏃᎮᏍᎪ ᏚᎪᎲ ᏍᎩ ᏳᏍᏗ ᏃᎴ ᏢᏛᏥ ᏱᎩ ᏲᎾ ᎴᏱᎦ ᎤᎾ ᏥᏦᏤ ᎨᏍᏗ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ -- ᎢᎾᎨ ᎠᏪᏙᎸ --ᎤᏒ ᏱᎩ ᎢᎦ ᎴᏱᎦ ᎦᏥᏲᏎᎰ Ꮭ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏥᎪᎥ ᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏳᏍᏗ ᏥᏲᎮᎰ Ꭱ bobcat. ᎾᎮᏂ What was it he had panther .. come in the house he said. ᏥᎾᏝ ᏣᏗᎲ ᏙᎭ ᎯᏰᎪᎩ ᏥᏥᏲᎮᎲ
segments.transliteration: howa yigeli nanv aninohesgv tla na heni atsutsa e tommy uwetsi na utanida kanohesgo dugohv sgi yusdi nole tlvdvtsi yigi yona leyiga una tsitsotse gesdi ilvhiyu -- inage awedolv --usv yigi iga leyiga gatsiyoseho tla ilvhiyu tsigov sgi na yusdi tsiyoheho e bobcat. naheni What was it he had panther .. come in the house he said. tsinatla tsadihv doha hiyegogi tsitsiyohehv
segments.translation: I would believe it. And just talking about it, no. That boy, Tommy’s son, the oldest, was talking about seeing them like that. Or lions and bears where we live. “I have been in the woods night and daytime. I have never seen anything like that,” I told them. A bobcat, what was it? He had a panther come in the house, he said. He said he owns it. I said “You sure are a liar!”

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Tommy?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: His son.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: His son, yeah.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: Ꮎ ᎠᏂᏲᏁᎦ ᏕᎧᏃᏎᎮ Ꭱ ᎠᏫ ᎠᏁ --ᏧᏪᏅᎲ ᎾᎥ ᏧᏔᏂ Ꮫ ᏚᏂᏟᎦ ᏧᎾᏔᎾ ᎠᏫ ᎠᏁ ᎤᎾ ᏕᎪᏎᎮ ᏙᏅ ᏩᏂᎷᎦ ᎠᏂ ᏲᏁᎦ ᎤᎾᏚᎵᎲ ᎤᏂᏃᎲᎵᏓᏍᏗ ᎨᏍᏗᏛ ᏱᏓᏥᏃᎲᎵᏙᎵ ᎤᎾ ᎦᏥᏲᎮᎸ ᎨᏍᏗ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᏍᏗ ᏱᎦ ᎥᏍᎩᎾ ᎦᏥᏲᎮᎸ ᎢᏣᏍᎪᏁᎮᏭ ᎦᏥᏲᎮᎸ Ꮩ ᎠᏁ Ᏺ ᎠᏫ -ᎠᏃᏍᏗ ᏗᏂᏓ ᎤᎾ
segments.transliteration: na aniyonega dekanosehe e awi ane --tsuwenvhv nav tsutani dv dunitliga tsunatana awi ane una degosehe donv waniluga ani yonega unadulihv uninohvlidasdi gesdidv yidatsinohvlidoli una gatsiyohelv gesdi gohusdi unesdi yiga vsgina gatsiyohelv itsasgonehewu gatsiyohelv do ane yo awi -anosdi dinida una
segments.translation: He was telling them White boys there are deer by his house that have big horns. Them Whites were going over there, wanting to go hunting. I told them “You all are not going to hunt. He has no say-so.” I said. “He is lying to you all.” There are deer, there, that are a pretty good size.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.text: ᎤᎾᎵᏑᏲ ᎡᏙ ᎢᎦᏗ Ꮩ ᎠᏂᎶᏒᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏙᎭ
segments.transliteration: unalisuyo edo igadi do anilosvsdisgi gohusdi doha
segments.translation: There are some that are mixed in that, like to exaggerate things, ain’t it?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᎩᎳᏫ ᏛᏴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏯᏗ ᏍᎩᎾ ᎠᏧᏣ ᎭᏅ ᏯᏩᏅᏘ ᏳᏍᏗ ᏁᎵᎲ ᎭᏅ ᏯᏩᏅᏘ ᏄᏓᏅᏛᎾ ᏱᎩ Ꮭ ᏯᏩᏅᏘ ᎠᏩᏢᎪ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ Ꮫ ᏱᏣᏃᎮᏟ ᎤᏟᎯ Ꮫ ᏱᎩᏓ ᏱᎧᏃᎲᎵ ᏃᎴ ᎠᏣᏗ ᎤᏂᏴᎲ ᎤᏟ ᏗᏂᏓ
segments.transliteration: gilawi dvyv gohusdi yadi sgina atsutsa hanv yawanvti yusdi nelihv hanv yawanvti nudanvdvna yigi tla yawanvti awatlvgo gohusdi dv yitsanohetli utlihi dv yigida yikanohvli nole atsadi uniyvhv utli dinida
segments.translation: Yeah, that boy will say something real quick. I don’t know what he is thinking. I don’t know if he is crazy or what. I can’t figure it out. If you tell something, he will tell one bigger. And also, he says he caught fish this big [gestures].

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Or he caught more.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᏳᏓᎭ ᎠᏩᏢᎪ -- ᏯᏪᎵᏍᏗ ᏥᏰᏣᏍᏗᎰᏭ ᏙᏛ ᎠᏁᎵᎲ ᎠᏂᏐ ᏴᏫ ᏱᏚᏃᎮᏟ
segments.transliteration: yudaha awatlvgo -- yawelisdi tsiyetsasdihowu dodv anelihv aniso yvwi yidunohetli
segments.translation: Or more. Sometimes I don’t know what to think. I just laugh at him. I wonder what other people think when he talks.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Do you remember anything else, Mike?

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.text: ᏝᏍ ᏍᏊ Ᏺ ᏍᏊ ᎢᎦ Ꮎ --ᏣᏙᏓ ᏥᎨᎲ ᎡᎴ ᏣᏚᏓ Ꮭ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏯᏅᏛᏗᏍᎪ ᎤᏃᎮᏢ ᎤᎾᏛᏅ ᎴᏱᎦ ᏂᏗᎦᎵᏍᏛᏂᏒ ᏱᎩ ᏕᎦᏟᎶᏍᏗ ᎠᎩᏚᏥ ᏥᎨᎲ ᎤᏙᏓ Ꮎ ᎠᎹ ᎣᏍᏓᏗᏔᏍᎬ ᏣᏗᎲ ᎦᏅᎪᎬ Ꮲ ᎾᎯᏳ ᏥᎨᎲ Ꮭ ᎠᎹ ᏗᎦᎷᎦ ᏱᎨᎮ ᎧᎵᏦᏕ ᎤᎾ ᏢᏴ ᎠᎹ ᏣᏩᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᏬᎮᎸ ᏣᏗᎲ ᎡᏙᏓ ᏥᎨᎲ boy ᏍᎩᏛᏅ ᏥᎳᏏᏛᎲ
segments.transliteration: tlas squu yo squu iga na --tsadoda tsigehv ele tsaduda tla gohusdi yanvdvdisgo unohetlv unadvnv leyiga nidigalisdvnisv yigi degatlilosdi agidutsi tsigehv udoda na ama osdaditasgv tsadihv ganvgogv tlv nahiyu tsigehv tla ama digaluga yigehe kalitsode una tlvyv ama tsawahisdi gehesdi awohelv tsadihv edoda tsigehv boy sgidvnv tsilasidvhv
segments.translation: Not really. Did your dad or your grandpa, do you remember anything they talked about, or said, what was going to happen? Like I will make an example. My uncle’s dad, he said they were drinking water from a spring somewhere. Back then water didn’t come to the house, there. He said his dad told him “Someday you are going to have to buy water.” He said “Boy I doubted him.”

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: That’s what my dad used to say.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.text: ᎠᎹ Ꮕ ᏱᎬᎩᏩᏍᎩ ᎠᎭᏂᏂ ᏍᏈᏍᏓ ᎦᏁ ᎠᏪᎵᏒ ᏣᏗᎲ ᎣᏂᏃ ᎡᎵ ᎤᏔᏂ ᏥᎨᎲ ᎪᎯᏴᎾ ᏥᎩ ᎠᎹ ᎠᎩᏩᏍᎦ ᏧᏛᏅ
segments.transliteration: ama nv yigvgiwasgi ahanini squisda gane awelisv tsadihv onino eli utani tsigehv gohiyvna tsigi ama agiwasga tsudvnv
segments.translation: He said “Why should I buy water?” There is a lot here, he thought. The last time, he was older. And he said “Nowadays I buy water.”

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᏕᏣᏁᏟᏴᏌ ᎠᏗᏍᎬ ᏥᎨᎲ ᏃᎴ ᎢᏳᏍᏓ ᎠᎹᏟᏗ ᏕᏦᏢᏒᏅ ᏙᏛᏂᏍᏚᏂ Ꮫ -- ᎠᏗᏍᎬ ᏥᎨᎲ ᎢᏥᏩᏍᎨᏍᏗᏛ ᎠᎹ ᎡᎵ ᎣᏏ ᎢᏣᏈᏱᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᏗᏍᎩ ᏥᎨᎲ ᎯᎢᏃ Ꭱ ᏗᎨᏣᎵᏏ ᏓᎾᏛᏒ ᎤᏟ Ꮫ ᏳᏲᏟ ᏛᏂᎪᎾᏗᎮ ᏣᏗ ᏣᏬᏎᎲ ᎯᏃ ᎣᏂ ᏧᎾᏛᏒ ᏘᎪ Ꭱ Ᏺ -- ᎡᎵᏭ ᏱᎪᏩᏔ Ꮟ ᏰᎯ ᏣᏬᏎᎲ
segments.transliteration: detsanetliyvsa adisgv tsigehv nole iyusda amatlidi detsotlvsvnv dodvnisduni dv -- adisgv tsigehv itsiwasgesdidv ama eli osi itsaquiyisgesdi adisgi tsigehv hiino e digetsalisi danadvsv utli dv yuyotli dvnigonadihe tsadi tsawosehv hino oni tsunadvsv tigo e yo -- eliwu yigowata si yehi tsawosehv
segments.translation: He used to say it was going to change. And also, he would say “They are going to close the wells we have.” He said “You all are going to be buying water and paying a lot. And when your grandchildren grow up, they are going to see some sad things.” He told me, for this younger generation. He said “You might see some it, if you are still alive.”

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.text: Ꮎ Texas ᏚᏯ ᏫᏕᏣᏕᏍᎬ ᏣᏗ ᏢᏍ ᏍᏊ ᏄᏓᎴᏍᏛ --ᏫᏤᏙᎸ ᎨᎮ?
segments.transliteration: na Texas duya widetsadesgv tsadi tlvs squu nudalesdv --witsedolv gehe?
segments.translation: When you said you all were picking beans in Texas, did you all go to other places?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: You mean the beans we were picking?

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Yeah.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: Yes.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: What different places did you go?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: Wisconsin.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Did you all take those bean pickers?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: semi ᎢᏛ truck ᏥᏓᏂᏢᏍᎬ ᏥᏓᎾᏂᎩᏍᏗᎲ ᎤᎾ ᎦᏳᎳ ᏳᏬᏤ ᎩᎳ ᏥᏓᏂᏲᎯᎲ ᏃᎴ ᎠᎭᏂ ᎧᎸᎬ ᏗᏝ Alabama ᏧᏬᏤᎲ ᏍᏊ
segments.transliteration: semi idv truck tsidanitlvsgv tsidananigisdihv una gayula yuwotse gila tsidaniyohihv nole ahani kalvgv ditla Alabama tsuwotsehv squu
segments.translation: Ah, they used to put them in a semi-truck and send them. We would already be there when they brought them. And, also towards the east, we would go to Alabama.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: They probably were not small, plowed fields.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᎲᎥ, ᎡᎵ ᎤᎪᏗ ᏃᎴ Texarkana ᎾᎥ ᏧᏬᏤᏙᎲ
segments.transliteration: hvv, eli ugodi nole Texarkana nav tsuwotsedohv
segments.translation: No, it was a lot and we would go close to Texarkana.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Did you like doing that?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: Ꮩ ᎠᎩᎸᏉᏗ ᏥᎨᎲ ᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏗᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᏙᏲ Ꮎ Ꭱ ᎤᏬᎵᏗ ᎠᎩᎪᎲ ᎥᎾᎾ ᎥᏕ ᏍᏊ ᎤᏬᎵᏗ ᏱᎨᎮ Ꮎ ᏥᏈᏍᏓ ᎤᎦᎾᏅ Alabama ᏬᏤᎲ ᏚᏯ -- Ꮭ ᏱᏙᎬᏕᏎ ᎾᎯᏳ ᏒᎾᎴ ᎠᎦᏍᎬ Ꭱ -- ᏓᏤᏝ ᏗᎩᎪᎵᏰ ᏚᏯ ᏕᎦᏕᏍᎬ ᎦᏥᏲᎮᎸ Ꮎ ᎠᏂᏧᏣ pickup Ꭲ ᏬᎦᏣᏅ ᏬᎦᏂᎩᏒ ᎤᎾ --ᏭᎨᏛᎵᏴ ᏳᏍᏗ -ᎤᏍᏗ ᎠᎹ ᏭᏕᏴᏛᏗ boy ᎤᎾ Ꮫ ᏍᎦᏍᏗ ᎡᎬ ᎠᎹ ᎠᎭᏂᏅ ᏗᏝ -ᏚᏂᏫᏒ ᏚᏯ Ꮎ ᏗᎾᏍᏛᏥ ᎯᏛ ᏗᎦᏅᎯᏓ ᏓᏂᏂᏙᎲ Ꮎ club Ꮎ Ꮩ ᏥᏓᏃᎮᎾ eel ᏍᎨ ᏳᏍᏗ ᏓᏂᎯᎲ ᏓᏂᏍᏆᎸᏂᏏᎶᏍᎬ ᎢᎦ ᎣᏍᏓ ᏗᎦᏰᏍᏗ ᎬᏬᎮᎲ
segments.transliteration: do agilvquodi tsigehv sgi nusdv digilvwisdanedi doyo na e uwolidi agigohv vnana vde squu uwolidi yigehe na tsiquisda ugananv Alabama wotsehv duya -- tla yidogvdese nahiyu svnale agasgv e -- datsetla digigoliye duya degadesgv gatsiyohelv na anitsutsa pickup i wogatsanv woganigisv una --wugedvliyv yusdi -usdi ama wudeyvdvdi boy una dv sgasdi egv ama ahaninv ditla -duniwisv duya na dinasdvtsi hidv diganvhida daninidohv na club na do tsidanohena eel sge yusdi danihihv danisqualvnisilosgv iga osda digayesdi gvwohehv
segments.translation: I did like things like that—working outside. I seen something funny, or it really wasn’t funny. It rained a lot when we were staying in Alabama. Beans-- We didn’t pick that morning, it was raining. I told them boys “We better go look at them bean pickers.” So we got in the truck and left. There was kind of a draw where water flows by. That water was flowing hard. They had beans planted on this side. Them Black men had clubs this long [gesture] what do they call them? Eel, they were killing. That kind. They were clubbing them. They are good to eat, they were telling me.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: You didn’t try it?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: Yeah.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Was it good?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᎣᏍᏛ ᏥᎨᎲ, ᏙᏳ ᎠᏮᎨᏩᏏ ᎾᏂᏪᏎᎲ ᏣᎳᎩ ᎬᏗ ᏍᎩᎾ
segments.transliteration: osdv tsigehv, doyu awvgewasi naniwesehv tsalagi gvdi sgina
segments.translation: It was good. I forget what they call them in Cherokee.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.text: ᎠᏯ Ꮫ ᏍᏊ Ꮭ ᏯᏩᏅᏘ ᏱᎦᏅᏛᏗ
segments.transliteration: aya dv squu tla yawanvti yiganvdvdi
segments.translation: I don’t know either, I don’t remember.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᏣᏁᎲ ᎮᏂ Ᏺ ᎤᏪᏴ ᏍᏊ ᎪᎯᎦ
segments.transliteration: tsanehv heni yo uweyv squu gohiga
segments.translation: There used to be some in the creeks, a long time ago.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: We are going to finish now.

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.translation: We are going to finish now.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.text: ᎢᏂᏍᏆᏗᏍᎬ Ꮓ ᎣᏂ ᏛᎬᏯᏛᏛᏂ Ꭿ ᏥᏄᏍᏗ ᏣᎳᎩ ᏥᏂᏬᏂ Ꮩ ᏫᏓᎦᎵᏍᏔᏂ ᎮᎵ?
segments.transliteration: inisquadisgv no oni dvgvyadvdvni hi tsinusdi tsalagi tsiniwoni do widagalistani heli?
segments.translation: As we finish, I am going to ask you this last thing—this Cherokee, like this we are talking, what do you think is going to happen?

segments.speaker: bird-wolfe
segments.text: ᏙᏳ Ꭽ ᏯᏩᏅᏘ ᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ -- ᎨᎵ ᎢᎨᎵᎰ ᏛᏳᏂᏐ-- ᏛᏳᏂᏲᎱᏎᎵ ᎨᎵ ᎢᎨᎵᎰ
segments.transliteration: doyu ha yawanvti yulisdodi -- geli igeliho dvyuniso-- dvyuniyohuseli geli igeliho
segments.translation: I don’t really know what is going to happen. I think they are going to lose it.
